It was void in physical existence. “and darkness was upon the face of the deep”: the deep is the elements God used to fashion the earth. He manipulated the elements to materialize what was pictured in his mind. “And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters”: the Spirit moved upon the elements.

“And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.” God imagined what light should be. “And God saw the light, that it was good”: when he created it, he compared it to the image in his mind, and it was good, meaning it conformed to his thoughts. He did the same with the earth: when it was all done he said it is good, because it matched the earth he had in mind before it was even created.

Because we are made in his image, we have the ability to do the same thing: to organize and put things together in our minds before they become physical. That is what Christ is saying: “Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.” Everything you lay your eyes on, apart from the ground, the vegetation and the water, came from a thought. People cannot believe that IUIC can envision its buildings before bringing them into existence, but we are supposed to think like our Father. If filthy thoughts can become filthy words, actions, character and destiny, the same mind can materialize righteousness and build the city on the hill that is already in your mind.

“the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.” The Romans took the kingdom away from us by force. Part of the kingdom of heaven is being able to envision our nation and lay down the foundations for how it should operate, here on this earth, with our children, our women, everyone in order. Christ and the angels will come and give it to us physically, with power, but our minds have to be ready for it, so we need to be rehearsing it now.
blog/2026/2026-01-10-2026-01-10-america-:
“He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.” The oppressing sword is the wicked, the sword of Psalms 17:13. And an oppressing sword is being risen up all over the earth, especially on the western hemisphere, and especially amongst our people.

Everything you see taking place with ICE, with how America went into Venezuela and snatched up its president, Trump telling the leader in Colombia he is next: that is the oppressing sword. We are living in the beginning of sorrows. It is going to get worse and worse, beyond the worst things you could think of. You thought World War II was bad; wait till you see what is about to happen on this earth. Don't sit back and be comfortable because nothing has happened to you yet.

God is using America, that administration, as his sword to bring judgment on the earth. It is the wine cup of Jeremiah 25:15: “Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.” And Jeremiah 51:7 shows whose hand that cup is in: “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” Babylon is not just ancient Babylon; it is America. What is in that cup is falsehood, lies, oppression and ill dealing, and that is why the nations are becoming angry with America.

So under that oppressing sword, many fall, and the cry goes up: “let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity”. This is why Daniel 4:17 matters now: the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, he has raised up the wicked as his sword over this side of the world where Israel is, and he is using it to bring judgment on the earth.

Daniel says “the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will”, and Solomon shows how: “The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” God turns the king's heart wherever he will. Whatever the Lord wants the king to do, he is going to do it.

So even in these last days, God gave who is ruling the world today. America is the superpower, and God put Trump in that position. Everything you see Trump doing today, God is allowing it. He is snatching people up off the street and sending them to prisons in other countries, and that is not outside the hand of the Most High.

This answers the question our people ask: why is God allowing Trump to do the things being done on the earth? Because the heart of that king is in the Lord's hand, and the Most High is setting up over the kingdom of men whom he will, even “the basest of men”, to bring his judgment to pass.

Why is God allowing Trump to do what he is doing? David answers it: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword”. The wicked is God's sword. The so-called white man is God's sword.

So when the Most High sets up “the basest of men” over the kingdom of men, he is taking up his sword. The wicked are not ruling on their own power; they are the weapon in God's hand, the same way the king's heart is in the hand of the Lord.

And the prayer shows what the righteous do while that sword is out: cry to the Lord to deliver our souls from the wicked. The sword is being used for judgment on the earth, and only the Lord can deliver his people from it.

Habakkuk says, “they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them”. That is how America and Europe are: they went into Venezuela and took a sitting president. “For they shall heap dust, and take it”: dust is confusion. Say he is a drug dealer bringing fentanyl to America, and then take him. “Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend”. Sirach warns us what that change is worth: “Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.”

America was always a violent people: they took this land from the North American Indians and put them on reservations, overthrew nations in South America, and went into Haiti in the early 1900s, took the gold and murdered the leaders. After 1945, when America became the world superpower and the head of the beast, it could not lead the world while still lynching and segregating openly. So it put on a new face of justice, peace and rights. That is why they gave civil rights, Section 8 and food stamps: not because they love you, but to pacify you. Now he is changing back to who he used to be. Make America great again means before the 60s.

You can shine a piece of iron and make it look good, but leave it over time and the rust appears. That is the white man's wickedness: it always comes back. “Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him”. In the civil rights movement he humbled himself, marched with us and said sorry for what his forefathers did, but “his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.” That is why people are surprised at the KKK, the Nazi supremacists and ICE. The Constitution was written when you was a slave, and it counted you three-fifths of a man.

“Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place”: do not make marriages with him and his woman. It happened in South Africa and in South American countries. After the civil rights era many of us forgot who the enemy was; some even have kids by him and say they love him, but God says never trust your enemy. “Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent”? The serpent is your enemy. If you go and befriend him and get bitten, nobody will pity you. We warned you.

“For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God.” That is America going into space; America was the first there, and America invented the airplane that ascends “above the heights of the clouds.” “I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north.” That is the Monroe Doctrine, now the Donroe Doctrine. The congregation is Mexico, Central and South America, Panama, Puerto Rico, Dominica, Jamaica, Trinidad and the Caribbean islands, where the twelve tribes of Israel are. America, the king of Babylon, the oppressor, sits upon the congregation and rules over us: fall in line, or what we did to Maduro we will do to you. And it is in the sides of the north, North America; that is why its treaty with Europe is called the North Atlantic Treaty.

Jeremiah shows where Israel is: “Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt; But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north.” The land of the north is North America. It is going to be said that the Lord brought the children of Israel out of this side of the world.

“and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.” Israel is in North America and all through this hemisphere, and 2 Esdras speaks of the ten tribes coming to this side of the world.

So the one who sits on the mount of the congregation in the sides of the north is sitting on Israel. According to prophecy, America will be sitting on these congregations in the last days, during the fourth seal, and bad things are about to happen on this side of the world. But the Lord will bring his people up out of the land of the north.

The Lord told Jeremiah, “Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.” All the nations are made to drink of that cup.

Then Jeremiah 51:7 tells you whose hand the cup is in: “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken”. Babylon is America. The Babylon of these days is not just ancient Babylon; it is America. The same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to pour on all the nations is in Babylon's hand, and the Lord is using America, its administration, as his sword to bring judgment on the earth. Whoever sits in office, the next one will take over and it goes on.

That golden cup goes into oppression: falsehood, lies, oppression. “the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” What is in the cup is not just riches but America's wrath and ill dealing, like going into Venezuela, taking its president, and then having millions of barrels of oil, about four billion dollars' worth, sent to America as tribute. That is why the nations all over the world are becoming angry with America.

“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” Prepared for what? Prepared for war.

Read on: “And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.” The dragon is the white man. These three are their politics, their religion and their economics, unclean things going out of the mouth of Edom.

“For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them”. Why are these things gathering the nations? Because they are oppression: America destroying people's economic systems, making war with nations, supporting the Israelis in the land over there, dropping bombs on Iran, going into Venezuela and kidnapping a standing president and calling him a drug dealer, saying it will take Greenland. These policies are the unclean things getting everybody around the world mad.

That is the madness of Jeremiah 51:7. The nations have drunk of Babylon's golden cup, and they are being gathered to battle because of what America has poured out on the earth.

This is the state of mind of the God we worship. Christ said, “I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?” The fire is already kindled. “Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division.” Christians believe Jesus Christ is about peace in this wicked kingdom. Nah. Christ came to bring division, war and destruction.

Ezra shows what that fire is: “Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.” Plagues upon the world: the sword, famine, death, destruction, war and diseases. And who is bringing these things? The Lord. Christ is the one sending these plagues on the earth.

You Christians running around with Jesus is love and everybody love: that is not realistic, and that is not what Christ came to bring. You can pray to white Jesus from now till whenever, but nothing is going to change; it is going to get worse and worse. He went on vacation during slavery and didn't hear you then.

We are living in the beginning of sorrows. If you think it is bad now, you don't understand yet; you are going to see some real horrible things take place on this earth, and shame on those who go back into the world. This year America is 250 years old, the average lifespan of an empire. That is why Trump is so gung-ho about making it great again: it is declining, and what it was built on is unravelling. The fire is kindled, and the plagues are coming.
blog/2026/2026-01-10-2026-01-10-destroye:
The Bible says God is a man of war. War is coming to this place; God is bringing war to the earth. And we should not be afraid of it. Isaiah 41: “For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee. Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel”. God is talking to us. Don't be afraid; he is going to help us.

Read on: “Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff”. A new sharp threshing instrument is a weapon, a weapon of war. The mountains are the nations, and we are going to beat them small. “Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them”. A time is coming when we will say, there was a place named America; what happened to it? It will be wiped out and never remembered again.

So when war comes, we should be celebrating, happy, not sad, because through those wars our salvation and our freedom come. We should pray for that thing. Our job now is to prepare for it, spiritually and mentally, not physically: prepare ourselves and our people, and keep a food pantry, as Bishop has been teaching for a while.

That preparing is spiritual warfare: “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh”; the weapons of our warfare are “mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. Don't get caught up in the foolishness of this place, the marches and the stupidity, even with your own family. Stay in the scripture, cast down every evil imagination in the minds of our people, and bring every thought “to the obedience of Christ”, the black Messiah. The man of war fights for us.

“Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors. Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else.” Only God is “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure.” Where do you find God’s counsel? The Bible. Whatever the scripture says, the prophecy is going to happen. Forget the dumb pastors and dumb Christians who do not know anything.

Amos shows who is behind what is happening: “Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?” The trumpet is the Bible. And yes, there is evil in America, and the Lord has done it.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” We are the prophets. Our job, brothers, is to prepare our people for what is coming. Our job is not to pick up guns and knives thinking you can do something to the white man; this man will wipe you out just like that. Our job is to bring the people back to Messiah and prepare their minds for the second coming of Jesus Christ, the black Messiah, revealing the Bible plainly so they may repent. Wait on the Lord.

“come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.” We are Zion, and our job is to declare in Zion the work of the Lord: what is coming, and how to fix your spirit and build yourself up. To our brothers and sisters in Venezuela: repent. You cannot stop the white man; let him do what he was supposed to do. The evil in the city is the Lord’s counsel standing, and it is revealed to his prophets.

“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne.” That is Esau: no more throne, no more power. She calls herself a virgin, and Nahum shows what she really is.

“Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery.” This is the bloody city right here. America is full of lies and robbery: they rob all the nations, and everything that comes out of their mouth is a lie. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” America is that harlot. She destroys families and destroys nations and calls it democracy, bringing freedom, yet does not follow it herself. She sanctions the International Court of Justice when it brings charges against Netanyahu; that court was made to judge the black nations. The white man is above the law.

“Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face.” God is against this place. He is going to discover America’s skirts and reveal her wickedness: America is not a virgin, she is a hoe who has been sleeping with everybody. “and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.” He is going to show the whole world how evil this place is.

For centuries they murdered, killed and robbed with no cameras, and said, “None seeth me.” Now social media records it and people see the evil in Venezuela, and still they look at the camera and say that is not what happened. The virgin daughter of Babylon who says none seeth me will have her nakedness uncovered before the nations, and through that, our deliverance and our salvation are coming.

“The Lord hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.” We are Zion. Our job is to declare in Zion the work of the Lord: to bring the people back to the Most High, to reveal the Bible plainly to our people that they may repent, and to prepare their minds for the second coming of Jesus Christ, the black Messiah. Fix your spirit, build yourself up, and wait on the Lord.

Christ said, “And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.” We are seeing that today. Do not be troubled by it. If you want salvation, if you want to see the return of Christ, those things must come to pass.

So our job is not to pick up a gun or a knife against this man. He will wipe you out just like that. The brothers and sisters in Venezuela must repent; they cannot stop the white man, so let them do what they are going to do, come out of the churches and stop being fooled by the pastors.

“but the end is not yet.” Right now the northern kingdom is on the front line, but do not think they will not come after the southern kingdom too. A time is coming when they come after us, and some will be put to death, some set up by the man smiling next to them saying shalom, paid to take them down. Read on: “For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.” We see nation rising against nation now. That is why we declare in Zion what is coming and how to prepare for it.

“Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.” To supplant is to betray, to plot. Job knew what it is to be betrayed by those closest to him: “All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.”

That is how Maduro was taken in Venezuela. It was betrayal from within. His own elite bodyguards, handpicked for their loyalty and trained to take a bullet for him, took American money instead. The outer guards were told to stand down, the cameras and alarms were disabled, and the last two bodyguards surrendered without firing a single shot. The same thing happened to Jovenel in Haiti. Those were our people, the northern kingdom, and they handed him over. And Esau planned it for more than a year, studying who could be turned: one with a sick daughter, one bitter that others were promoted over him, one disillusioned.

The same spirit is among us. Other Israelite camps want to destroy IUIC by slandering the members and the leadership, because black people will believe anything without proof. They slander the Bishop, the deacons and the captains every chance they get, and then come to the door asking to fellowship. We are good. We don't believe the same thing, and we will never come together with them.

And inside: the brother who says, why is he a captain, I know more scripture than him, why do the young men always travel with the Bishop? Maybe the young men are thirstier for the word than you. They know they don't know everything; you think you know it all. Fix that spirit, or you will be the next traitor, the inward friend turned against those who loved him. God hates a traitor.

“Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.” The last part is the point: the kisses of an enemy are deceitful. And Luke shows the kiss: “Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?” Judas betrayed Christ with a kiss. The man betrayed him with the very sign of love.

Today we do not greet each other with a kiss like that, but we have our own greeting: Shalom, Captain, Most High bless. That is the betrayal. The embrace, the salute, the Shalom, and then the knife. That is the kiss of an enemy.

We saw it in 2018. A man who had been in another man’s house, greeting him with Shalom, barbecuing together, traveling together, came to that same man’s house, took all his furniture and put his children on the cold floor to sleep. He did not care. Not only did he betray the man, he betrayed all his children.

There is nothing worse than a traitor. And some of you think once you betray your brother or your sister, that is the end of it. It is not. The one who betrays with a kiss will be dealt with too. That is why the kisses of an enemy are called deceitful: Judas is the pattern of the familiar hand that destroys.

“For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it.” It was not the enemy that set David up, or he would have been ready, because he knows who the enemy is. “But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance. We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.” It was the man he trusted, the man he went fishing with, and that took him by surprise. Later in the same psalm David describes that man: “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.”

A man mine equal: an officer of ten, of twenty, of fifty, just like me. We took sweet counsel together: Deacon, I need counsel; Captain, what do you think about this? But while he was taking counsel, he was plotting. Some are plotting to take your wife: she is too beautiful for him. Some are plotting to take your position at the job you brought them into, telling the white man, give me his position. I picked him up every Sabbath and every Wednesday, and when he came to betray me he had no problem doing it.

“Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.” Christ was betrayed that way: “Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?” Today we do not kiss, but we dap: Shalom, Captain, Most High bless. That smooth greeting can be the betrayal. In 2018 a man who sat in another man's house, barbecued and travelled with him, came and took all his furniture and put his children to sleep on the cold floor.

Jeremiah warns: “Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.” Supplant means betray, plot. Other camps slander our members and leadership, because they know our people believe anything without proof; they are Esau in black skin, who “have taught their tongue to speak lies.” They come asking to fellowship, but we are not stupid.

It was not the enemy that killed Thomas Sankara; it was his best friend, who grew up with him. It was Maduro's own handpicked bodyguards who stood down and handed him over, taking American money instead of a bullet for him. That is war in the heart behind smooth words. David is telling you: do not fall asleep.

“He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.” Venezuela is a peaceful country. America put an embargo and sanctions on Venezuela for twenty years to destroy its economy; the money goes down, everything goes down. Then twenty years later: he is a drug dealer, he is this, he is that; people of Venezuela, we can change your lives. America did that. “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart.”

Only the simple will believe it was about drug trafficking. Trump pardoned one of the biggest drug dealers a couple of months before, and Mexico, on America's border, has more drug cartels than any place in the world. Then the story shifted to oil. They use the same stupidity because they know some black people will believe that garbage. Ninety-nine point nine percent of the words that come out of the Trump mouth are a lie. He lies even when he is not talking; he is blinking and lying, and every person who works for him too.

David shows why: “The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” The little baby is born, he does not even talk yet, and he is looking at you lying. That is Trump: before he can say a word he already starts lying. All of them. God said it, not me: it is in them to be liars. And our people believe them, because they are white. Who told you the white man cannot lie?

Habakkuk describes the same man, whose “soul which is lifted up is not upright in him.” Esau is not right: “he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”: he is in everybody's business, with bases around the world used to overthrow any government that does not do what he says. He destroys the economy with sanctions, sends in CIA agitators and propaganda to raise the people up, and then comes back as the good guy offering to help. Like a man who rapes a woman and then offers to take her to therapy.

That is putting forth his hands against such as be at peace with him. The wicked go astray from the womb speaking lies, and his smooth words always have war in his heart.
blog/2026/2026-01-10-2026-01-10-the-high:
Deuteronomy 7:6 says the Lord chose Israel “to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.” Deuteronomy 28:1 says it as well, with the condition attached: “if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth.”

If God says we are above all people and above all nations, then why can we not do the things we have a concrete visual example of other nations doing, and doing for decades? When one of the Amish gets married, the community comes together and builds a house for that couple, and there is no mortgage attached to it. They do not even have power cars. We have enough knowledge, enough builders, plumbers and concrete men; we can do this too, at a higher level.

It is going to take work to build this kingdom: work, and faith that we can do the work, shown by our actions. We need to fix our credit scores, fix our health, learn group economics, and work together in the trades, so that when the tough times come, losing your job because of your last name or because you are tracked, we have things set up to help each other.

This is the highway of the upright, the Israelite's strait journey. Ezra saw that “A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things”, but “The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall”, with fire on the right hand and deep water on the left, and one path “so small that there could but one man go there at once.” That city is the kingdom of heaven, and we must pass through all these things in this captivity to inherit it.

At the end of it, “the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.” We were ransomed out to the nations, but we are returning and gathering together. Being set on high above all nations is the promise to the people who hearken and do the work.

Looking on the things of others means building something together, and economics must be part of our mindset as we walk to build a nation. Solomon says: “For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.”

Wisdom is a defence: generational wisdom passed down from father to son, grandfather to son. Esau has law in his house, and the grandfather passes the torch and teaches hard lessons that save heartache; that is why they had the head start, and why they are so relaxed at their jobs. We are behind in everything. Half of black folks have a credit score below 620, locked out of access to capital; before we wake up in the morning, half of us are in bondage.

Money is a defence. Walking the commandments, evil is going to come upon you: what happens when they take your job? So build businesses we can self-employ in, food distribution, brothers helping each other. Teach your children about secured loans and secured credit cards and the three credit bureaus, Experian, TransUnion and Equifax. And a single, divorced brother paying out his money has less of a defence than a man married in proper order.

“wisdom giveth life to them that have it”, and to have it you have to be taught it. That is why they try to stop us from teaching that we are the twelve tribes of Israel: scattered, we lost our nationality, heritage and commandments. The father in the house, with Christ at his head, is the one to break that cycle.

“Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.” If I esteem you better than myself, then within my power I have to help you come up with a solution, or help provide it. “Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.” That does not mean just looking: yeah, he's struggling like hell. No. Look means action. “Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus.” And Christ was no weak, effeminate man; he was a strong, powerful, upright man.

Paul says it plainly: “Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.” That is how we are going to rise. If twelve of you have cars that run fine and a brother in the body can't even fix his car, and you shut your mouth and do nothing, you are weak. That is not how our black men are supposed to stand. Israelites are commanded to help each other.

So every school should have its mechanics, carpenters, plumbers and electricians helping the people in the body, making videos so the next brother can do it too. Instead of paying $1,900 you pay $300 for the parts, and brothers with the spirit fix the car. That's alms deeds; that's helping your nation.

We used to have that. Black people used to speak to each other in the street because we had a commonality, a common struggle. Now we have fallen apart. Bearing one another's burdens is how the nation is gathered together and becomes an economic force: that is the mind of Christ and the law of Christ.
blog/2026/2026-01-11-2026-01-11-christ-t:
Paul says those who depart from the faith give “heed to seducing spirits.” Mark shows where that seducing spirit comes from: “For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.”

The false Christs and false prophets rise on TikTok and Instagram. These Christians under Israel's banner, the fake Israel's banner, get millions of dollars, and America works her science for Israel. We are in that time. We push Revelation 2:9 and 3:9; you don't think one of them will say, shut his bank account down, that'll shut them up?

“Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.” We are literally the offspring of God, and idols are not him. “And the times of this ignorance God winked at”: he had mercy and was longsuffering with us, “but now commandeth all men every where to repent”, all Israelite men everywhere.

How do we answer that command? “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. The Bible tells the Israelites to gather together, not to be separate individuals. That is for all of you online who like to stay home and say, I don't like camps. Do what God said to do. Come in, learn, sit down and be quiet.

Some say, I want to come to the school, but I'm not right yet; I'll come when I get right. When is that going to be? You come to the school to get right; none of us are 100% right, we're all trying to get right. You aren't going to get right in your wicked mama's house or with your homeboys. Not gathering shows you love Babylon and white Jesus, that you're okay with black people shot down in the streets and on drugs, and it delays the coming of Christ.

Gather “Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you”. Then: “Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment”, the curses of Deuteronomy 28; “seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.” Joel says the same: “Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children”, and let the priests cry, “Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them”.

Because of verse 1, with no comforter and all the power on the side of our oppressors, Solomon says: “Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.” Better than both is he “which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.” He would rather praise the dead, who are not going through the oppression, than the living, who are depressed, oppressed, suppressed, pressed all kinds of ways.

Job said the same: “Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?” Job was going through tribulation hell: his wife on him, his kids dying, the skin disease, his lands, everything lost. Why didn't I just die already? Why am I still here?

“For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest”. If he had slept, meaning been dead, he would have been at rest, not going through the hell he was going through; or as “infants which never saw light”, meaning stillborn. “There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest. There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.” We are the prisoners. In death they don't have to deal with oppressors no more.

That is how heavy the oppression of Ecclesiastes 4:1 is. And the only reason we are still breathing is the mercy of the Lord, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

“behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power”. That's us. Our oppressors have power: they organize themselves, pass laws and policies, colonize, oppress and exploit. And the Israelites had no comforter.

So what is supposed to comfort us? Paul says: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” Whatsoever was written aforetime means this Bible, and it was written for our learning. We ought to learn from what happened to the Israelites, to the apostles, and to Christ.

“comfort of the scriptures”: this is our comforter. The scriptures of this Bible are where the oppressed find comfort, and that is what we need to hope in.

The oppressors hold all the cards right now, and the one who has no comforter in the world has one in the word. If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, the nations would have swallowed us up; it is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed.

“A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth.” America is that treacherous dealer. An American economist who advised more than a hundred governments calls the United States the most lawless and dangerous country in the world, with CIA coups he saw with his own eyes and the Iraq war sold by a focus group in the Pentagon. It puts sanctions and embargoes on a country, kicks it off the SWIFT payment system, cripples its economy, and then pays protesters and sends Mossad and the CIA to stir up the people against their own government, as in Iran. It took out Gaddafi, who wanted to unite Africa on the gold standard and used his oil wealth for his people, and Libya is a mess to this day. That is how they deal: underhanded, with the CIA, Mossad, guerrilla warfare and mercenaries, as in Haiti, to monopolize the resources of all the dark nations.

Jeremiah shows the counsel of the Lord against the treacherous dealer: “Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom.” Edom in this context is the USA, America.

“and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman.” Teman is Amalek, the state of Israel. “Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.” The least of the flock is Israel, Amalek, and it shall draw America out.

So the treacherous dealer and spoiler of Isaiah 21 has a counsel of the Lord taken against it. The same Edom that spoils the nations will be drawn out by the least of the flock, and its habitations made desolate together with them.

Keep Jeremiah 49:20 in mind and compare it: “Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans.”

In Jeremiah 49 the counsel is taken against Edom; here the same counsel is taken against Babylon. Edom is America, and Babylon is America. In Jeremiah 49 it is purposed against the inhabitants of Teman, and here against the land of the Chaldeans: that is Amalek, Israel.

“Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.” Word for word the same. Amalek is going to draw America out, and he shall make their habitation desolate. “At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved.”

That is the proof that Edom and Babylon are one: the treacherous dealer who deals treacherously and the spoiler who spoils in Isaiah 21 is America, the Edom and Babylon of these two prophecies, and the Lord’s counsel stands against it and against Amalek with it.

The virgin daughter of Babylon says, “I am, and none else beside me”: I am the one, not the French, not the Arabs; big bad America; my military is in all countries and nobody can do a thing about it. “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: your science, technology and weaponry have perverted you, and now all you do is drop bombs from drones. “Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”, “and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly.”

Isaiah 24 shows who else is judged with her: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.”

The high ones that are on high are Esau in his pride. And with him the kings of the earth, the other nations upon the earth. All nations will be punished, and there is not a thing they can do about it. If the Israelites got punished, why would you not get punished? You have to be punished too.

So Babylon coming down to sit in the dust is part of that day. The Lord brings down the proud one on high first, and the judgment reaches all the kings of the earth.

“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon.” Babylon, America, is up on high, a proud nation, and God says he will bring her down. “thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”, because the prophets will be revealing this devil to his face on the streets, and the world is going to know this is the man of sin, the son of perdition. “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh”: take off that head covering; you are no righteous woman, you are a hoe. “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance.”

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood.” Death and fire are coming to Babylon, “for the multitude of thy sorceries”: the evil America perpetrates throughout the earth, the LGBT, the murder, the colonization, the imperialism, the genocides.

Is “in one day” read elsewhere? Revelation 18: “Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” That great city Babylon is America, that mighty city no other nation could defeat. In one hour, in one day, her judgment comes.

That one-hour judgment is coming for America. What are you going to do about it? Are you going to survive it? Are you going to put in the work, change your life and repent, or keep playing games because you think you have a little more time?

Jeremiah's word came “against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.” The Philistines are the Palestinians. Some scriptures are twofold, threefold, fourfold: Pharaoh smote Gaza then, and today Netanyahu and the Israelis, Amalek, smite Gaza.

Isaiah shows what happens to the one smiting: “That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot”. The Assyrian here is Amalek, and Amalek will be judged. “then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders”: Amalek's yoke departs from off the Palestinians. “This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.” All nations are going to get judgment.

But jump to verse 29: “Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken”. Palestinians, do not rejoice because Amalek is moved out of the way. “for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent”: a missile. “And the firstborn of the poor shall feed”, and the firstborn of the poor is Christ; “and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.”

“Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke”. Palestine will be dissolved. Not only Amalek, but the Palestinians have to get out of that land too. “the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.”

Remember what Isaiah 14 showed: the Palestinians are going to be destroyed out of that land, and so is Amalek. Zephaniah says it plainly: “Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast”. The sea coast is Gaza. “the nation of the Cherethites” is the Palestinians. “the word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.”

“And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks”, when those missiles hit. Then: “And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.”

The house of Judah will live in Gaza. That is Judah's land, and Benjamin will be there too with the house of Judah. Give the Lord a hand for that.

That is why Jeremiah 47 goes on, “O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet?” The sword cannot be quiet, “seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” Gaza is the seashore. The judgment on the Philistines clears the coast for the remnant of Judah.

“O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.” A scabbard is the leather sheath you put a sword in. How long will judgment be quiet? “How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” The seashore is Gaza. The Lord gave the sword a charge, so judgment has to go forth, and missiles are coming there too.

Who is that sword? David tells us: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword.” The wicked is the sword of the Lord. That is why this class is called Donald Trump: the Sword of God. The Lord uses the wicked to bring judgment on the nations.

And it is judgment on all the nations, not just Esau. “Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.” Concerning the Ammonites, Ammon, the Japanese: “Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?” Gad is mixed among them. So “I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap”, and “then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs.”

Then Babylon, which is America, and the land of the Chaldeans, Amalek, the so-called Israel: “Put yourselves in array against Babylon”, “spare no arrows”, “for it is the vengeance of the Lord.” Joel says, “Prepare war, wake up the mighty men”: China, America, Russia, Iran, all must go to war and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat, where the Lord will sit to judge all the heathen round about.

When the sword has done its work, the land comes back to us: “And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah”, and “the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.” The house of Judah will live in Gaza. And when Babylon falls in one hour, we are told, “Rejoice over her”, “for God hath avenged you on her.”

Jeremiah's word is “against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans”. Babylon here is America; the Chaldeans are Amalek, so-called Israel. And it is not just Esau: it is judgment on all the nations. “Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord.” “for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.”

Joel shows who is called up to do it: “Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up”. The Gentiles are the other nations, and the Lord wants them to prepare war. China, America, Russia, Syria, France, Great Britain, Iran, Saudi Arabia: they all have to go to war. All you military men, wake up. It is time to go to Armageddon.

“Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.” Make weapons; you finished boot camp, now go to war. “Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.” Wake up, Esau; wake up, Ishmael. The valley of Jehoshaphat is the valley of decision, and they have to go there and die.

“Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe”; “for their wickedness is great. Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.” The nations arrayed against Babylon are the sword of the Lord bringing his vengeance on her.

“He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. He taketh the wise in their own craftiness”. The crafty are the nations, in particular Esau, that counsel against us and keep exploiting, oppressing and colonizing with imperialism. It is the same as Psalms 21: “they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.” Their counsel is carried headlong; they are going to fall headlong and bust their forehead. “They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.”

“But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.” From Esau's sword, the nations' sword. Who is the poor? Isaiah answers: “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.”

Write it down, brothers: when the scripture talks about the poor, it is talking about Israel, the poor of his people who trust in Zion. That was an easy one, and every soldier should know it.

And before the Lord saves the poor from the sword, the wicked has to be identified. The man of sin must be revealed, so that the whole earth knows who he is: the nation that bombed country after country, removed leader after leader, and made the earth to tremble.

“And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” Are we free today? Hell no. Do we know the truth today? Not as a nation. So what is the truth that makes free?

Christ prayed, “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.” Sanctify the Israelites through thy truth, mainly the elect, the apostles he was speaking of. And the truth is the word: “thy word is truth.”

So to know the truth is to know what the word says, and the word that is truth says a day is coming that shall burn as an oven. Knowing that truth is what frees our people from the lies, and it is the first step before the Lord saves the poor of his people from the sword of the nations.

This is the word that is the truth: “For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”. The day is coming that is going to burn like an oven. Nuclear fire is coming to America. What are you going to do about that, and how are you going to survive it?

“and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: burnt up like stubble in that day, unless ye repent. “and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch”. Your children will be cut off too.

Psalm 21 sounds just like it: “Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them. Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.” Neither root nor branch left. And Isaiah 14: “Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers”. The forefathers committed the crime, took the wealth and everything from us, and now the children are left holding the bag: Esau, and not just Esau, Elam, Ishmael and the Hamites, all got wealthy off the backs of the Israelites and had us in slavery one way or the other. The Lord will “cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew”, the same son and nephew, root and branch.

“For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.” The nations counsel against us, but the Lord takes the crafty in their own craftiness and saves the poor, Israel, from the sword.

“The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” The king in this nation right now, in 2026, is Donald Trump. His heart is in the hand of the Lord, and whatever way the Lord wants him to go, he is going to go, and he is going to fulfill what the Lord has in store.

Daniel shows why: “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men.” God rules in the kingdoms of men. God is the ultimate ruler.

And what does he do? He “giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.” He gives the kingdom over to whomever he chooses, and he sets over it the basest of men: the least of men, the bottom feeders. The bottom feeders are ruling us right now. Biden, Trump, Putin, all of them: they are the bottom.

So the king’s heart turning like rivers of water and the Most High setting up the basest of men are the same truth. Trump is not ruling by his own power. He is set up by the Most High and turned whithersoever he will, a sword in the hand of God to bring judgment on the nations.

Psalms 124 goes on: “Then they had swallowed us up quick”, the nations would have swallowed us up, “Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:” “Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.” The waters are not the water of affliction. Write it down, brothers: the waters in Psalms 124 are the nations.

Isaiah proves it: “Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!” Keep reading: “The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters”. He is comparing the nations to waters.

“but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.” That is the Lord being on our side: the proud waters, the nations, rush against Israel, and God rebukes them.

King David says, “If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say”: the Lord was on Israel’s side, “when men rose up against us”, when the nations rose up against us. Think about that. The only reason we are still breathing is the mercy of the Lord.

Lamentations says it plainly: “It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.” That we, brothers and sisters, are still here is only because of the Lord. With the weapons Esau has and the weapons the nations have, if the Lord put the spirit on them to do what they do and gave them free reign with us, we would all have been wiped out.

Read on: “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.” “The Lord is my portion, saith my soul”. His compassion does not fail, and that is why Psalms 124 can say the nations did not swallow us up.

“The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression”. Being longsuffering is one of the characteristics we must take on with our brothers and our sisters. A lot of times we are carnal and have no patience with each other. A brother offends you, or does what you think is an offence that he may not even see as one, and you get all in your feelings; sisters get in their feelings about something somebody said or the way somebody moves toward them. We are all different spirits joining together for one common goal. We are not all going to get along, but we all have to be longsuffering with each other and endure it.

Then: “and by no means clearing the guilty”. Why is he of great mercy but will by no means clear the guilty? Just because you sin and are not judged immediately does not mean you will not be judged; you are still guilty of that sin. And to get that great mercy, you have to repent and forsake your sins. The ones he will not clear are those that do not repent, and he visits “the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.”

So back to Psalms 124: it is of the Lord’s mercy, longsuffering with Israel, that the men who rose up against us did not swallow us up.

One more precept on the waters: “The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” The waters are peoples and nations again, and the one sitting on them is America. Look at where America sits: bases and fleets all over the earth.

So what could Russia do with this? America does not have to send its entire fleet to Russia or to China; it is already there, it does not have to go anywhere. If I was Trump, I might boast too. Look at the weaponry he has.

That is the power of the nations the Psalm is talking about. “Then the proud waters had gone over our soul”, but “Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.” Because of the Lord’s mercies, “Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.” And “Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth”: that name is God’s commandments with faith in his Son.

“Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.” That sounds just like Malachi 4: “the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”, and “it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” Nuclear fire is coming to America. And David goes on: “Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.” Neither root nor branch: their children will be cut off too.

Isaiah shows why the children are cut off: “Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers.” For the sins of their forefathers. The forefathers committed the crime, got the bag from us, took the wealth, took everything from us, and now the children are left holding the bag. Esau, and not just Esau: Elam, Ishmael, the Hamites. All of them got wealthy off the backs of the Israelites; all of them had us in slavery one way or another.

It is done “that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities. For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew.” Son and nephew goes right back to Psalm 21 and the end of Malachi 4: their seed destroyed from among the children of men.

Why? “For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.” They imagine evil devices and evil counsels against us, but “He disappointeth the devices of the crafty”, and “he saveth the poor from the sword.” The poor are Israel: “the poor of his people shall trust in it.” So the fiery oven is for the nations that enslaved us, down to their children, and the Lord saves his poor from their sword.
blog/2026/2026-01-17-2026-01-17-judgemen:
“Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses.” Who can show the things from the past? The next verse answers: “Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen.” God’s witnesses on this earth are the children of Israel, and the two sticks, the stick of Judah and the stick of Ephraim, the southern and northern kingdoms, are two witnesses also.

What does a witness have? A testimony. A witness testifies, like a witness to a crime in a court of law. And we do not play a small role. Isaiah shows what God’s witnesses testify: “To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.”

As witnesses, what we are supposed to be testifying is the law and the testimony. If they do not speak according to this word, the law and the testimony, there is no light in them.

The testimony is what John bore record of: “the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.” Part of that testimony is to identify “them which say they are Jews, and are not”, the synagogue of Satan. And Malachi’s testimony: “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness.” The they who call them that are the witnesses, the prophets. So when the nations are gathered and asked for witnesses, Israel stands to the law and to the testimony.

“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord.” A witness has a testimony. What is the testimony Israel carries? Sirach shows where it came from: “Fill Sion with thine unspeakable oracles, and thy people with thy glory: Give testimony unto those that thou hast possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in thy name.”

The testimonies are what God gave to Moses, to Jeremiah, to Nahum, to Micah, to Isaiah, to Peter, Paul and the apostles. All the things these men wrote are the testimony: testimonies of things that are going to happen in the future, of what is going to happen to the children of Israel.

So when the scripture says the witnesses have to testify, the testimony is what is written, what the prophets said is going to happen. That is why Isaiah 43:9 asks “who among them can declare this, and shew us former things?” No other nation can. Israel, the people God possessed from the beginning, was given the unspeakable oracles, and we testify them.

And as we testify, we bring forth judgment. Brought before governors and kings “for a testimony against them and the Gentiles”, it is not we who speak but the Spirit of our Father speaking in us. The wicked who hides as an angel of light is revealed and condemned, because the witnesses must testify first before God brings forth judgment, as in a court of law.

“He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.” When our people are oppressed, God opens their ears. All the things Trump is doing, and ICE is doing in the streets and in the black community, are God opening your ears. For the last 60 years our people have been lost and confused, following the American dream and thinking America is about equal rights and opportunity. God said, no, this place is not your rest. So he turns up the oppression, because that is the only time we as a people turn to God: when bad things start happening to us.

Hosea says it: “I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.” Until we acknowledge our offence and seek God's face.

In our affliction we will seek him early: before it is too late, before we die, before judgment comes. So God is allowing Trump to do these things in the black community with these ICE agents so that you will seek him. Our people are realizing that the American dream is exactly what it is, a dream, and that there is no such thing here as justice and equal rights. That is why judgment starts first with the house of God.

Psalm 78 shows the same pattern: “Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.” The trouble is affliction. “When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.”

When God slew us. What do you see taking place all over the streets right now? Our people being oppressed, locked up, put in prison by ICE officers. Then we seek God. That is when we return and enquire early after the Lord: when bad things start happening to us.

That is why judgment must begin first at the house of the Lord. Number one, for us to turn back to our God. Number two, to prove us: as you turn to him, bad things will happen to see whether you believe and trust in him. “And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.” He is the one who will redeem us from the condition we are in.

And Isaiah 30 gives the teachers their job: though the Lord gives the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, the teachers will not be removed into a corner any more. As our people cry under the affliction, we go to them and tell them why it is happening: this is the way, walk ye in it. Not guns, as some are calling for; the word of God is what will change our people and bring destruction on this place.

Christ said “Take heed that no man deceive you”, and then: “ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.” Nation against nation, kingdom against kingdom, famines, pestilences and earthquakes: “All these are the beginning of sorrows.” That is the time we are living in right now: the beginning.

Ezra shows it is only the beginning: “For yet greater evils than those which thou hast seen happen shall be done hereafter.” Greater evils. The things you see taking place on the earth are only the beginning. It is not going to get better, and it is not going to go away. The Democrats are not going to come into office and change anything and make it better. God says it is the beginning of sorrows.

“For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell therein.” The older the world gets, the weaker it becomes, and we are at the end of it right now. The evil is war, death and destruction, and it is going to increase.

So when you see these things, do not be troubled and worried about what is taking place. The world has changed and it is not going to be the same. Work on getting yourself right, and prepare for what is coming.

“Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off”: God will cut you off, cut off from the book of the living. Proverbs shows what is really behind slander: “He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.”

When somebody lies on you or slanders you, what that really says is that there is hatred there. The lying lips are hiding hatred.

“and he that uttereth a slander”: you had Tyre Gas, you had Lightfoot, you had these guys uttering slanders, and their followers talk that way because their leaders are the same way. They run with slander. As a leader you are supposed to hear an outrageous lie and say, I do not believe that. One woman said we came to Canada on a magic school bus, and some leaders believed it.

God says you are a fool to listen to lies, run with them and put them out there. Slander is defamation: running with an accusation without two or three witnesses, and God cuts that man off.

“A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.” If you lie on somebody and run with slander, it says that you hate the one who is afflicted by it.

You heard it plainly from one of them: I am here to down IUIC. That is the hatred behind the lying tongue that Psalms 101 says God will cut off.

Every matter is to be established by two or three witnesses. What was put out about Captain Obadiah was one witness, and that witness was a lie. The charges were dropped; the footage and the witnesses showed he was defending himself. It is sad that the white man had to come and say he was defending himself, when those who talk about righteous judgment could not understand something that simple. In London, when our sister died, people said IUIC killed her and hid evidence, and the investigators showed that the man who did it was evil and we had nothing to do with it.

A false witness is called slander, or defamation, and false witness can get you killed. By the law, what was to be done to the brother you slandered is to be done unto you. We do not have power to institute that, but Esau’s court system has defamation, and that is how it is going to be done now: whatever you put out against the truth, you had better be able to prove it, or you will have to come up out of the pockets. That is to protect the ministry of Christ, because the lies are put out to blame the ministry.

“Strive not in a matter that concerneth thee not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.” That is why so many brothers get caught up in suits: striving in things that do not concern them, things they know nothing about. You just hear something and you are running your mouth.

To sit in judgment with sinners is sitting in counsel with brothers that are not right, brothers who were put out of the school, like Judah Mack and Titus.

Read on: “My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent.” This is for those who keep running their mouths talking about us. You meddle in matters that do not concern you, and you are not going to be innocent. That is why legal measures are being taken: to teach men to control their mouths, and to make sure that when you say something, it is true.

So the privy slanderer of Psalms 101 is the man who strives in what does not concern him and sits with sinners, and God will cut him off.
