Zillah bare “Tubal–cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”: Tubal-cain designed weaponry. Then Lamech, of the same line, boasts to his wives: “I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt. If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.” Anyone who tries to avenge himself on Lamech, he will rain hellfire on them. That line through Cain is the lineage that comes back again as Esau, and it was given the art of weaponry.

So Isaac’s word over Esau fits: “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above; And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother”. By his weaponry he lives. He was to serve his brother, but his skill with the sword would be so great that “when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.” He breaks the yoke his brother had over him.

And the principalities, the powers, the thrones he rules through were all created by Christ. Edom’s might comes from the one who made him.

That is the war we are in. Isaiah 14 calls him Lucifer and the king of Babylon: “how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” He weakens the nations through war, and “smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”, mostly God’s people. We have watched it: a whole country’s defense taken down and its president taken out in thirty minutes, jets shot out of the sky in ninety-three seconds, sonic weapons that left soldiers bleeding without a bullet fired, as in Panama in the eighties, and DARPA always twenty years ahead. They changed the Department of Defense back to the Department of War, because they know a name matters, as we should know the name of Israel matters.

Our people see that power and think he must be God, or that God must be with him. That is the great war of ignorance. Revelation 13 asks what the world asks: “Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” But his pride has deceived him: “I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.” He will fall, and when these devils fall, “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.”

“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work”. Who created Cain, Lamech and Esau? Christ did. He gave them the ability to have dominion and power, principalities, spiritual wickedness in high places.

That is why the class went first to Genesis 4, where Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”. Isaiah, prophesying of the days to come, speaks of that same smith: the maker of weapons that began with Tubal-cain and Lamech.

Then the verse goes further: “and I have created the waster to destroy.” There is the smith, and there is the waster. An arrow, a dart, a knife or a sword does not destroy by itself; the waster destroys. God made the one who forges the weapon and the one who uses it to lay waste.

So when Edom builds Space Command in Huntsville and calls it Rocket City, when his weaponry is twenty years ahead of anything we know, remember Christ said he created the smith and the waster. “Babylon, the glory of kingdoms” draws every nation that wants a piece of the American dream, and the dragon gives power to the beast: the devil himself gives power to the beast, the white man. “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.” Even that power was given him.

Our war is not according to flesh and blood. His weapons are not only for fighting other nations; they are to force white supremacy into our minds and spirits, until most of our people in the four corners of the earth worship the white man, even in congregations where everyone looks like them. But the Lord reminds us that they are men and not God, and their pride is the thing that brings them down.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” Lucifer is another name for Esau, alongside Tyrus and Edom, and further up the chapter he is called the king of Babylon. How did he weaken the nations? Through war. A US destroyer took down two fighter jets in ninety-three seconds, having calculated seventeen ways to kill them before they reached altitude. Venezuela’s defenses, its bases and its president were taken in thirty minutes. That is why his pride is lifted up, and why the ignorant say he must be God.

Isaiah 13 names what he is: “And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms.” The Space Command headquarters moving to Huntsville, Alabama, now to be called Rocket City, means more weaponry, the smith and the waster that God created. Babylon is the glory of kingdoms: all these nations want to come to Babylon and get a piece of it. They call it the American dream.

The world is amazed at the beast: “Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” But that same verse of Isaiah 13 says the glory of kingdoms shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. The Lord “hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers. He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”, primarily God’s people, is brought down.

So the glory of kingdoms falls from heaven like Lucifer, and then “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” When these devils fall, the whole earth will finally be at rest.

“Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit.” That is the war of gods. On one side is the god still sitting in our minds, the image of white supremacy that was forced into our spirits; on the other side is the God of this Bible. The Egyptians set themselves up as gods, but they are only men, and all their weaponry is flesh.

Their weapons are not only for warring with other people. They are there to force a thought into our minds, to force white supremacy into our spirits. So the war is first in the mind, and the ignorance of our people is the battlefield.

“When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.” That is what Isaiah 19 shows: the Lord sets “the Egyptians against the Egyptians”, “city against city, and kingdom against kingdom”, and “the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof.” There is going to be civil war, and there will be wars from outside as well.

And when it comes, “they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.” They will cry out to the images they revered as gods, talking to those Jesus pieces, asking them to come save them. They will run back to the news outlets that lied for years, to Christianity, to every version of white supremacy. But men are not God, and none of it will hold them up.

So the Lord is teaching us war tactics, because there are going to be wars in the flesh. We have to keep strong in the war we already have in our spirit, knowing the ones who made themselves gods over us are only flesh.

Revelation 11 shows everybody where Egypt is: “their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.” This place, America, is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. So when Isaiah says “I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians”, he is speaking of civil war in this land, city against city and kingdom against kingdom.

That is why Isaiah 19 goes on: “The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof.” God put a perverse spirit here, and it causes this place to be in error in everything it does. Everything that America does is in error, because there is a perverse spirit here.

You can see it in the news. Trump went to the Ford plant, a worker called him a pedophile protector, and he shot the man the bird and said “F you”. The man was suspended, and the union is fighting to get him off suspension. Somebody called out the perverse spirit, and even when they are shown their errors, they flip you the bird and make sure you lose your job.

So Sodom and Egypt is not a far-off place. It is the land we are in, and the land that the Lord will turn against itself.

In Isaiah 45 the Lord says, “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me”. God surnamed us, and even though he revealed himself to us and delivered us numerous times, we kept turning our backs on him. “I am the Lord, and there is none else, there is no God beside me”. Some set themselves up as gods, and some create gods in their minds and as idols, but there is none with him. “I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things”.

Exodus 15:3 fills in the picture: “The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name”. The same Lord that forms the light, creates darkness, makes peace and creates evil is also a man of war. That is the overall picture of the Lord our God.

Psalms 46 shows what that looks like: “Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth”. Pharaohs were worshipped as gods, Xerxes thought he was a god, and Antiochus Epiphanes thought he was God manifest on earth; rulers rise in power and rise in pride. But “He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder”. The man on the thumbnail who has claimed for two years that he will stop the war between Ukraine and Russia has not stopped anything. When the Iron Dome in Israel failed and the rockets came through, that was no technical glitch; the Lord ripped it open. He makes the prideful instruments of man fail, because he decides where war happens and when it ceases.

And that God of war, who formed the light and created darkness, is Christ. He is our refuge, and he teaches his soldiers to do the same: “Blessed be the Lord my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight”. He handpicked us to be soldiers in his army.

The vision of Obadiah is a prophecy concerning Edom, a time to come, and we must be occupied in prophecies. The Lord says, “Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” Edom will be greatly despised. Then he shows why: “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”. They are so prideful that they themselves are deceived.

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: they are the cavemen. So Karen has nerve telling you don't park there, you don't belong here, being black while in Starbucks. You was in a cave. Now their pride has deceived them into thinking they are the wise of the earth, the most civilized of the earth. No: they are the most demonic of the earth.

“Whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” They ask that question as though they are God. Ezekiel shows the same prince of Tyrus, for Edom was also called Tyrus: “thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God”. Their bases sit in the midst of the seas. “Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee”: through all their technological advances they listen through your smart TV and your phone, and by that wisdom and traffic they got riches and lifted up their heart.

That pride grows from the weaponry given to that line from Tubal-cain and Lamech down to Esau, who by his sword would live. The Lord created the smith and the waster. In Isaiah the same one is called Lucifer and the king of Babylon, who weakened the nations through war: “I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.” With all this military might they feel like they are the Most High, and people see it and say he must be God or God must be with them.

But the answer to “Who shall bring me down to the ground?” is the Lord. “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer”. He is going to fall because his pride has reached up unto heaven, and when these devils fall, the whole earth will finally be at rest.

“Blessed be the Lord my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight.” We serve a God of war, the God that formed the light and created darkness, and that God of war is Christ. David is speaking of how the Lord equipped him with his mighty fighting skills, and the same man of war teaches his soldiers to do the same. Paul says it: “Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.”

The God of war handpicked every one of us to be soldiers in his mighty army. We are in a boot camp, a training camp, and he is teaching us how to war. Some brothers think they are here just for the unleavened bread, just to be around the brothers. No. Everything going on in the earth, in your household and in the congregation is a teachable moment, because there are spirits in all of it, and we are being built up to deal with those spirits.

It is a process. You start with yourself, subduing your own body, and that is ongoing until you go in the grave. Then your household, then the congregation, as a leader helping other brothers and sisters do the same. Even when you hear somebody else being corrected, it is about you, because at some point you will stand in that same position.

Judges shows why the nations are here: “Now these are the nations which the Lord left, to prove Israel by them”, “to teach them war.” The nations are the Lord's sword to teach us war. If you think that means go get your Glock, you are being simple. “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh.” At Ai the Lord said, “I have given into thy hand the king of Ai”, and still told Joshua, “lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.” The victory is already ordained, but you must go about it the way the Lord commanded. The spiritual side of the war is obedience.

So endure hardness. Some send emails saying, I am no longer with IUIC, I am going to take a break. Taking a break from the Lord? That will not work. A good soldier does not entangle himself with the affairs of this life; he stays in the fight to please the one who chose him.

Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”. He worked metal, and at that time metal meant tools of war; he was not making decorations for your house. The mark followed Cain’s lineage: sin, violence and hatred were in his spirit. Where an artist sees art in raw material, his mind saw weapons. Weaponry came into the earth, or at least advanced, through Cain’s line. Murder led to industry, hatred led to technology, and violence led to institutional power, the hegemony that controls everything.

Then that spirit comes through Esau. “Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.” Isaac answered, “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above”: he would have rulership and authority. And the connection to Tubal-cain: “And by thy sword shalt thou live”. The fatness of the earth, everything he has, he gets by violence.

Then: “and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck”. That happened once our kingdom passed. We had a kingdom for a little while, and since then we have never been in any kind of power up to this day, while he increased through the process of time.

We see it in the graphic of Trump straddling the Western Hemisphere, the Monroe Doctrine renamed the Donroe Doctrine: this is mine. That is the one that sits upon many waters. The wicked are revealed, restrained for a time with a hedge around them to fulfill what the Lord wants, and then comes their final judgment.

“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work”. The Lord is over all of it. He puts it on Satan, his emissary, and Satan passes it around. It is twofold: it speaks of the brass and iron of Tubal-cain, and then it names something more.

Notice “an instrument”: not all weaponry, one in particular. Then he names it: “and I have created the waster to destroy”. What weapon at that time could have been called the waster? Nothing. Zechariah describes it: “Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.” Nobody could have imagined such a weapon then. They had no word for nuclear weapons or atoms, so they saw visions and explained them the best they could: it is the waster.

Malachi says, “behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: Esau, the other nations, and rebellious Israel that does not repent. The day that cometh burns them so “it shall leave them neither root nor branch”. A fire leaves ash; this leaves nothing. Peter says “the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. The nations know it: their treaties against nuclear proliferation show the Lord staying their hand, because whoever uses one ends the world as they know it. Isaiah 29 says the strangers “shall be like small dust” and it shall be “at an instant suddenly”, not like regular fire, and all the nations that fight against Ariel, the lion of God, “even all that fight against her and her munition”, her weapons, “shall be as a dream of a night vision”, gone that quick. They filled their bellies and lived deliciously, and in an instant it is all gone. God put it in their spirit to make that thing, and he will use their own weapon, the thing that gave them their power and respect, to end them.

This should move us. The Lord “is longsuffering to us-ward”; the day waits until the set number is sealed, and it comes “as a thief in the night.” “Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”? Paul says the same: “let us watch and be sober”: do not drink of her wine, do not sleep thinking you are an American and nothing can touch you. “For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ”. So “comfort yourselves together, and edify one another”: this is the time to be more united, not divided over simple issues. We look boldly for that day, because “we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness”: a baptism by fire that cleanses the evil and makes the earth fit for the kingdom.

Lamech told his wives, “I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt. If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.” That was cold-blooded murder, killing with no anger behind it, for the thrill of it. Cain killed in anger; if he is judged, how much more Lamech, who just had violence in him. He boasted in it. It went beyond Cain; it increased. That is when murder was normalized and celebrated in that line.

That is why Esau has the same spirit: “And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.” It is in his spirit till this day. Rebekah was told, “Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.” Killing is a comfort to him. Trump boasted that the Venezuela raid was very violent, and said of the boats, we are just going to kill them.

“Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran”. The only thing Jacob could do was flee; he could not stand against that bloodthirsty violence. It is the same spirit as Cain: patient, vengeful and calculated. Cain lured his brother into the field; Esau said, I will wait until the days of mourning are done, and get him when he least suspects it.

That spirit is the son of perdition. “Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition; Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God”. It says revealed, not elected: he was ordained from the beginning. Ezra was told, “Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau. For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” People blame Jacob for grabbing the heel, but none of them had done good or evil in the womb; it was a sign, and Jacob was always supposed to be in rulership. Christ said, “those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.” He is not kept; he is ordained for destruction.

The Lord “shall destroy with the brightness of his coming” him “whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders”: the bomb, the weapons, the industrial complex and the economics. So it runs like a ring: Cain murdered his brother Abel, his line built weapons, Esau plotted to murder his brother Jacob, Isaiah 14 reveals the oppressor of the nations, and 2 Thessalonians shows the man of sin fully manifested in these last days. The spirit did not disappear; it evolved from individual murder, to weapon maker, to institutional violence, to global domination, a man who says nothing can stop him but his own morality. But “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet” once he is laid down.

Cain “brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord”, and Abel brought “of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof.” “And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect.” What happened to Cain and Abel physically is a foreshadowing of Jacob and Esau spiritually: one is chosen and one is not.

Paul explains it with Rebecca’s twins: “For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth”. Then: “As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” Cain was not rejected because he was wroth; that was ordained from the beginning. It is about election, the purpose God makes. He can make one vessel for one use and another vessel of wrath fitted for destruction.

Christians take “not of works” to mean the law need not be kept. What it tells us is that from the foundation God chose his elect. He still requires the works of the law, not the sacrificial law, but being clean and repented, to obtain the kingdom of heaven. When the first world was formed every nation was supposed to follow the laws, and judgment followed whoever did not. Cain’s rebellious nature showed itself, and it continues to this day in Esau.

People say God doesn’t hate, and they isolate “God is love.” But notice it says “as it is written”: it is in the Bible. It was written first in Malachi: “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” Edom says, “We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”, and he did, in the Renaissance. But the Lord says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” God lets him rise to power so that he can take him down.

And the Lord asked Cain, “Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?” Remember that, because the same reason Cain hated Abel is the reason Esau hates Jacob today. It is the same spirit; only the name changes. “Satan” simply means adversary, one who obstructs and opposes. That is why everything they do is about us: they were made for that purpose, to obstruct and oppose us, because God purposed it from the beginning.

The Lord asked Cain, “Where is Abel thy brother?”, and he answered, “I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?” But “the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground. And now art thou cursed from the earth”. That curse is layered, but the ultimate curse is the utter destruction of Cain and his seed, and it has not yet been fulfilled. It is a deferred judgment, held “until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”: a set time that has to be fulfilled of these heathen nations, starting with Esau as the top one. It is the same spirit of Cain today. Unless we accept who this man is, the son of perdition, nothing else about the last days will make sense.

The Lord told him, “a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth”. Apart from the little land he had in the kingdom of Esau, he takes up the identity of others: he calls himself the Greeks, when the real Greeks were black, of the Japhetic seed; the Romans; the last samurai; the Israelites and the Egyptians in The Ten Commandments. The confusion of faces was supposed to be his curse, and he flipped it onto us, until we became the astonishment, the proverb and the byword.

Cain feared that “every one that findeth me shall slay me”, and “the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.” Why not judge him right then? Because God had a purpose for him, as he raised up Pharaoh so that his power would be magnified when he comes to redeem his people and the earth.

Job tells us what the mark is: “If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.” The mark is sin. And sin preserves him, because sin is witchcraft: by it he seduces the nations that might stand against him into the confederacy of Psalm 83. They all know what he is, but lust, the love of money and power, make them put that aside and ally with him, the way criminals make alliances knowing one day someone will stab them in the back. Under Trump that confederacy is starting to crack.

So Cain is protected only for a time. The judgment was promised through Esau: “I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste”, and they shall call them “The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” That border of wickedness is the mark. “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” If not Esau, the United States of America, who is he? And “evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him”: his demise will come the same way he ruled.

Why would a mark of sin protect Cain? Solomon answers: “For the bewitching of naughtiness doth obscure things that are honest; and the wandering of concupiscence doth undermine the simple mind.” Sin is bewitching. It is seductive. It hides what is honest, so that, as the scripture says, if it were possible even the elect would be deceived.

That is how the mark works. Cain’s line would have rulership for a time, and he would rule the earth with darkness, with sin and with evil, and people would be enticed by it, Israelites included. Our northern kingdom, the majority of it, fell for it, and now they are getting their wake-up call, though there was always a remnant that rebelled against the colonialism they saw in Latin America.

The bewitching is also how the confederacy holds together. The other nations know what he stands for; it is common knowledge. But the love of money, power and rulership says, put that aside, this is the one it was given to, nobody else could get me these things. So they ally with him, and there is no honor among thieves with this man. We watch him boast of taking Venezuela’s president in an operation so fast and violent, threaten the vice president with worse, and name Colombia and Mexico next.

But the spell does not last. “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” We know who brings him down: first those he dealt with turn against him, and then Christ and his elect have the glory and honor of taking him down. The wicked are revealed and restrained for a time, a hedge around them until they fulfill what the Lord wants, and then comes their final judgment.

“How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel?” God is saying, how am I going to turn away from you, my son, and deliver you forever to the heathen? Admah and Zeboim were the cities round about Sodom and Gomorrah that were utterly destroyed, and he cannot do that to us. Though he strikes us with righteous judgment in these curses, he has not forgotten us. “I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger”: all the horror of these curses we deal with is mercy.

What comes after the repentance is the honor, and Zechariah shows it: “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope”, that is, repent, and “even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”. Then: “When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.”

This is talking about a weapon. Judah is bent first, like the bow, and then he fills the bow with Ephraim, like an arrow. It is the same order as Hosea 11:10: he roars like a lion because the tents of Judah are raised first, and the northern kingdom sees that example and follows it, and the children tremble from the west, from the western hemisphere. Thy sons, O Greece, goes into Edom, Esau, Cain, all these countries that rule with a fist of iron.

“And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning”. That arrow is us. Christ leads the charge, and we get to move like that too, with the two-edged sword in our hand to execute vengeance upon the heathen, the honor all his saints have. “they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar”: we partake in the vengeance, like the blood of the sacrifice filling the bowls thrown on the altar. We don't just stand by and watch it.

So we don't fight physically now; we repent now and fight through preaching, and God fights for us later. He will place us in our houses, tell us, you're from Asher, you're from Ephraim, from Simeon, Issachar, Zebulun, Naphtali, and give us back our royal heritage and our identity.

How do we bring about that change? How do you fight a nuke? How do you fight powers that can turn off your lights, run your economy and take your resources right under your nose while you say thank you? With something small and simple: “For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.”

It was God’s wisdom that the world would not know him, that they would purposely not be able to understand. It is given unto us to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God; he made everything a mystery so that only his elect can unseal what the Bible says. And just as it pleases him to see a man lifted up in power so that he can take him down, it pleases him to save by the foolishness of preaching. That is how we get our identity back. That is how we come back.

So look at the brothers in the streets. Don’t think those efforts are small; they are making an impact. Even if your camp doesn’t have a lot of foot traffic, none of it is in vain, none of it is void. You go out, you preach, you gather, you fish. Even if there are scarce fish in that water, if you know there is a spot where fish be, you stay there until you catch at least one. You are not trying to come home empty.

It starts with preaching and then it escalates. First we repent, then we get the honor. We do not fight physically now: we repent now, we fight through preaching, and God fights for us later. Then comes the honor of Psalm 149, “a twoedged sword in their hand; To execute vengeance upon the heathen”, for “this honour have all his saints.” When he shall roar, “the children shall tremble from the west”, the western hemisphere, “and I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord”: our tribes, our royal heritage and our identity given back to us, the sons of the living God.

Hosea says the children of Israel shall be “as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered”: dispersed, so that we could be preserved. And “in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.” We are hearing that now and seeing it now. Our teachers tell us these things, we identify with them, and that is how we regain our identity.

Solomon’s prayer shows the steps: “Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness”.

First we have to bethink ourselves: remember ourselves and reclaim our identity, right here in the land of our captivity. That is part of the strangeness of our salvation. Then we repent and make supplication, and then God will acknowledge us, be for us and fight for us.

This is not a time of peace but a time of war. Not physical war: there is nothing we can do against these powers and nations physically. What we can do is unite as a people, come back together, keep God’s laws in solidarity, and wait on our Redeemer. In the place where we were called not his people, we remember who we are, we repent, and we are called the sons of the living God.

“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people”, sometimes willingly, sometimes not. You have knuckleheads who say that is only talking about their customs. It was biological and it was symbolic, dummy. The Bible defines the Bible, and Ezra shows what mixing means: “The nation of Israel, the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land, nor the pollutions of the Gentiles.”

We did not put away the strange people from the land. We sought after them, because of the ideology of whitening, of bettering the race. The pollutions of the Gentiles are their idolatry and their doctrines, and we became corrupt in our merchandise and commerce. All Israel had that propensity, but here the focus is the northern kingdom.

Read on: “For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land.” When it says mixed himself among the people, it means the seed gets mixed. What is the seed? Sperm, semen. So when somebody comes to you with that BS, this is the scripture to put there: mixing means mixing.

It goes on: “and from the beginning of this matter the rulers and the great men have been partakers of this iniquity.” All of us partook of that, and it is a sin to mix with the other nations. That is why Ephraim is a cake not turned: light on one side and dark on the other, all the different shades among the northern kingdom, and some of our own people with blonde hair and blue eyes whose father is Israel.

Ephraim mixed himself among the people and became “a cake not turned”, light and dark. Jeremiah shows how the Lord sees that mixed people: “Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.”

We are a speckled bird, and the birds round about against her are the enemy. They know who we are because of the caste system. Though we are mixed, they know who we are. In Panama they call the light-skinned ones one name and the darker ones, some of whom are Benjamin, another, and the lady at the hotel sized each of us up by our shade the same way.

But the Lord had a way to fix that, because the Israelite seed is that strong: go back to the Israelite line, and it does not matter how mixed the daughter was. And Hosea says Ephraim would “bring forth his children to the murderer”: Cain, Esau, Edom, the Spaniards, the United States. For those who willingly tried to whiten the race: “give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of those babies died.

So the speckled bird is still his heritage. “How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel?” Though he struck us with these curses, he will not make us as Admah and Zeboim, the cities round about Sodom and Gomorrah that were utterly destroyed. Our job is to give the word, go to the chief places where our people resort, and let God do the separating.

“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people.” Ezra already showed that the holy seed was mixed with the strange people of the land. David gives the other side of it: “But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.” It was not just ideological, dummies, and some of the ones saying it went to seminary school and call themselves theologians. When you look up the definition of mingled, it goes into mixing, just like First Esdras. And they learned their works too.

So Hosea is talking about ideology, and it is also talking about the seed, like we just proved. Scholars know the whitening was both ideological and biological. “Ephraim is a cake not turned. Strangers have devoured his strength.” The cake not turned is the colours, light and dark: some of us light, some in between, some dark.

The strangers devoured more than the strength of the royal seed. Our strength lies in the Lord, the joy of the Lord is our strength, and the ideology cut us away from him. We cannot fight the United States; our countries cannot do any of that. It is time we come back to God. Strangers devoured his strength, “and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.” Many of our older people are not hearing it; the gray hairs are upon them and they cannot accept it.

And this goes with Matthew 13 and Amos 9, especially for you northern kingdom brothers. Southern kingdom, learn northern kingdom history with the same vigour and zeal that we learn yours. If you are a fisher of men, you fish all the different kinds of fish that pertain to Israel and Christ.

Ephraim was “planted in a pleasant place”, the blessings, but “Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The murderer is Cain, Esau, Edom: the Spaniards, the United States. That was the whitening, el blanqueamiento, sometimes done willingly and sometimes not. So God said “give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of the babies of those who tried to whiten us out died, and what is left behind is largely not European; many who look European there came over later. Our job is to give the word, go to the chief places where our people resort as Christ taught, and let God do the separating.

How could a people fall so low, go through so much, and still rise and reconnect to their identity? People are baffled by it; to them it is ignorant and even offensive for us to know who we are. Deuteronomy 28:45 answers it: “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God.” And “they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.”

Those curses became our identity, and our redemption. They are the way we acknowledge who we are and make our way back. If not these curses, then who is it? The Bible always said Israel would come back to its identity, and now that we are back, the world is bugging out. Where are the lost tribes? They are here now.

It is God's grand plan. If we were all together in one spot, they could have wiped us out. By dispersing us into the four corners of the earth he also preserved us, like the worm in the movie Swordfish, broken up and scattered to the four corners of the internet so no one could get it back without the one who hid it. What was our curse, God meant for good, so that now we can come back together. As Hosea said, the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, and “in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

Jeremiah says the prophets of old “prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” All the prophets made sure to speak of these things. It is bad news for everybody else but good news for Israel, because when we see these signs we see the time hastening for the Lord's people, his heritage. They are not uncertain; they are an assurance and an establishment of our faith. This is not a time to prophesy peace in the earth. The peace is among us: the middle wall of partition broken down between the northern and southern kingdom, no more alienation from Christ, his laws and our identity.

Isaiah tells us where to see it: “Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate”. We must read and understand so we can see these things. Too many of our people, even those repenting, are caught up in other things and do not think what is happening warrants their attention. Go back and read your scriptures more. The warnings and the shortening of days are there to put a fire under us so we seek out our own salvation with fear and trembling.

No other book gives this understanding. It has survived countless attempts to burn, destroy and alter it, and Christianity minimizes it to a book of love, hugs and kisses. That is a slap in the face, because most of the book is doom, destruction, war, judgment and recompense, and the people waiting on prophecy are always the oppressed.

“for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.” Christ's spirit gathered these things together so they would be plain to those who keep the commandments and be preserved for us to use in these last days. None of the prophecies of war, evil and pestilence will fail.

“The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.” “I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste”. That is what Paul refers to in Romans 9 when he says, as it is written. Esau went through some things at different times: they became the cavemen, came out of the caves and started taking people's identity, the fugitives and vagabonds that they were. But his ultimate, permanent judgment was deferred for a set time. “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”, and during the Renaissance they did. “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.”

Job shows why he has the power for now: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” The border of wickedness is the mark; people will know. And the indignation for ever tells you judgment was reserved for him, but God needed to use him for a time for his plan.

If not, who is he? If it is not Esau, if it is not the United States of America, who is it? The prophets saw visions of rooms like this: the president seated up high with the vice president and the speaker beside him, and the United Nations the same on a bigger scale, all the nations with their hierarchies on one accord. That is why the scriptures say they were confederate.

It is like Cain: he was supposed to be judged, pleaded, and the Lord put a mark on him and deferred it. Revenge is a dish best served cold. How much better to let this man get so high in power and authority that he thinks he can stop God, and then take him down.

Esau's judgment was deferred for a time, and Christ gave the time: “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.”

There is a set time that has to be fulfilled for these heathen nations, starting with Esau at the top: the same spirit of Cain in rulership. But it is temporary.

Through the process of time, waiting generation after generation for his judgment, Esau has forgotten it, or at least his pomp and pride make him think he is untouchable. Obadiah says, “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”, “that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” And who blames him? Look at what they just did to the air defenses Russia and China supplied. Trump now talks like that, of taking Venezuela and coming after Colombia and Mexico, and boasts that it was so fast and violent.

But it is prophesied who will bring him down. All those he dealt with will turn against him, and then Christ and his elect will have the glory and the honor to take him down. “evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.” When the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled, his time is up.

In the parable, “while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat”. A mixing happened: bad seed sown in among the good seed. “An enemy hath done this.” It was done on purpose. For the Northern Kingdom tribes in this hemisphere, that was the whitening the Spaniards practiced: marrying to lighter skin to better the race, with a whole caste system of names for every kind of mixing. They found the tribes, and since they could not kill us all outright, they tried to pollute the royal seed. But however watered down the daughter is, one man with the seed of an Israelite brings it back.

The servants asked, should we gather up the tares? “Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them. Let both grow together until the harvest”. It is not for us to determine, because of the way this went down; we do not know who is and who is not. At the harvest the angels will know who is Israel.

Amos proves it: “For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations”. Why among all nations? Because through the whitening, the mixing and the captivities, God himself has to be the one to sift us. “Like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.” It will be determined who is who. Even Adam had to walk through a gate; you do not have twelve gates with twelve names and think somebody is going to sneak through. God said he will do it. My sheep hear my voice, and you know them by their works.

“All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.” He is going to kill a lot of them, before, during and even some after. So we narrow down where our people gather and go to the chief places of concourse, not to where the Edomites are, and give the word; and let God do the separating.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” There is a set time for the times of the Gentiles to be fulfilled, with Esau at the top, that same spirit of Cain in rulership. But it is temporary. Waiting generation after generation for his judgment, the pride of his heart has deceived him. He forgot what his judgment is and thinks he is untouchable, especially after seeing what his weapons did to the air defences of Russia and China.

Now Trump is talking like that. On Air Force One after capturing Maduro he names the countries he will come after: Colombia, run by a sick man; Mexico, where the cartels are running things. He says the vice president of Venezuela will face a situation probably worse than Maduro, and emphasises how fast and violent it was: it was very violent. That office once had prestige, and though they did their evil, they at least spoke well. He is not even bothering with appearances anymore.

David shows where that ends: “Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.” You reap what you sow. What he puts out is the exact same way his demise is going to come.

That is the lineage of Cain: Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”, and where others saw tools his mind saw weapons. Murder led to industry, hatred to technology, and violence to institutional power. Esau was told, “by thy sword shalt thou live.” But who shall bring him down to the ground? It is prophesied: first all those he dealt with will turn against him, and then Christ and his elect will have the glory and the honour to take him down.

“Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” They do not abandon the law; they weaponise it. They wrote the laws, so they know how to get around them. The most powerful pen in the world, with a stack of bills beside it, is the president of the United States, and every nation bends the knee. Violence gets reframed legally in their decrees and doctrines: kidnapping becomes a law enforcement operation, sanctions become international order, theft becomes stabilising the region. When he promised to lock up the criminal illegal immigrants, you thought thieves and murderers; but by their law, anyone here without papers is a criminal. That is framing mischief by a law.

Micah shows how they work: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” When the morning is light means in broad daylight, because they can frame it by law, and he says his own morality is the only limit. It is in the power of their hand because they are after the working of Satan, given authority to set kings up and take them down.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” It is not just the resources; they want the identity too. Venezuela's vice president said the country was attacked by Zionists seeking to enslave the nation. Netanyahu, whom he calls his boss, visited before the attack. Machado, who won the Nobel Peace Prize and then gave it to Trump, promised to open the oil to their companies and move Venezuela's embassy to Jerusalem, because everybody has to bow the knee to the impostors.

Maduro said he is a Jew in his blood, from the twelve tribes, and that the man over there is not a real Jew. That is the heritage they are after. The ADL says it has analysts monitoring 24 hours a day and trains law enforcement, and in Patagonia Israeli tourists were caught setting fires in a protected preserve they cannot buy unless it is damaged. Their eye is on the land and on the lost tribes. They practise it in the light, because it is in the power of their hand.

Babylon's merchandise runs from “gold, and silver, and precious stones” down to “slaves, and souls of men.” The tin, the copper, the iron, the rubber, the bauxite, the slaves and the cheap labor have all been taken out of our countries. These countries are not underdeveloped; they are overexploited. They all should be rich countries, world powers, with the blessings the Lord gave us in those places. It was done in Latin America and in Africa, especially the west coast where we are dispersed, and the slave routes and trade routes were the commerce they made of us.

The way they keep that dominance today is economic, backed by the threat of military power, and it follows a pattern, as with Noriega and now Maduro. First they criminalize the leader with drug, terror and corruption narratives, framing mischief by a law. Then they declare the regime illegitimate. Then they apply sanctions and economic siege. Then they isolate the country diplomatically and militarily, remove or extract the leadership, and install or manage a transition authority.

The sanctions are the modern face of Deuteronomy 28:48, for those who say the curses were only for back then or only for the time of the conquistadors: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. Want of all things because of sanctions and their economic might. If you try to nationalize your resources or do things outside of their money, even though you have your own resources you are overexploited to the point that you cannot do it on your own. There is no might in your hand.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” A lot of times we did this willingly. It is the same pattern we followed with Assyria and Egypt: when the United States became a world power we leaned on them, and found out really quick that they do not keep their word on anything. It is history repeating itself, the doctrine of the scripture executed over and over again.

“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich).” First and foremost, the riches are the promise of the kingdom of heaven. Unto us pertain the promises, the law, the adoption of sons, all of it; we are the ones Christ died for. That is the true riches.

But Revelation 18 gives it a new spin. Babylon trades in gold, silver, precious stones, fine wood, iron and marble, and these come out of our lands. So-called third world countries are rich with resources; it is the people who are poor, because they are overexploited. What a distinction. The countries of Israel are not underdeveloped, and the poverty of our people sits on top of the riches of our lands.

“and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” Those who say they are Jews and are not are part of the same machine working to oppress our people, and it is the same playbook of sanctions, isolation and regime change that runs through the whole system.

So Revelation 2:9 stands beside Revelation 18:12: the merchants of Babylon grow rich off the goods of the lands where Israel is scattered, while Israel lives in tribulation and poverty, though rich in the promises and in the land itself.

Peter says, “Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness, Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?” The heavens will be on fire: what else could he be talking about? It is the waster of Zechariah, flesh consuming away while they stand upon their feet.

We hear all this and say, okay, great, but it should move us. What manner of persons ought we to be? In all holiness and godliness. Paul says the same: “Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.” Sober means don't drink of the mark of the beast, don't drink her wine, don't be so asleep that you think you're an American and nothing is going to touch you. God has not appointed us to wrath; he does not want his elect to be part of that death and destruction.

Looking for and hasting unto that day means you should be able to look boldly and say, I'm looking for it and I want it to come quickly. It is not the time to be divided in BS and simple issues, but to come together stronger and more united, growing in faith and understanding and applying it.

Don't worry that this place is going to be burned away: “Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.” That fire is a baptism by fire that cleanses all the evil and reforms the earth so it is fit for our new forms and for the new kingdom. Thy will be done in earth as it is in heaven: the kingdom is coming down, and this place has to be transformed.

Zechariah's plague and Malachi's day that burns as an oven are coming, so why has it not come yet? Peter answers: “The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.”

The only reason it tarries is that the Lord is waiting for us. It is not really a set time the way we see it: the time is when that set number is sealed, and God knows when that will be. That is why there is no date for it that we are aware of.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”: when you least suspect it, that is when it comes. “In the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. In those days they could not imagine what that sounded like; it sounded terrifying. Now that we understand it, it is no less terrifying, because we know what those nukes can do.

The Lord stays their hand enough that they do not want to use them. They sign treaties against nuclear proliferation because they know if one fires, the other fires back, and it's a wrap, a zero-sum game, the end of the world as they know it. It is like the game Civilization: it lets you build and use a nuke, but once you use it the game ends, because you destroyed the whole earth. The Lord holds it back while he waits for his people to come to repentance.

The Lord said, “I have created the waster to destroy.” What weapon at that time could have been called the waster? Nothing. Zechariah describes it: “Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.” Could anybody then fathom a weapon that did those things? Malachi shows the day it is fulfilled: “For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”.

The prophets did not know about nuclear weapons and atoms back then. They got these visions and explained them the best they could, and the best way to say it was: the waster. God put it on man to make that instrument, and there will be a day when that plague is fulfilled.

“And all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: not just Esau and the other nations, but even rebellious Israel, the ones that do not repent. “And the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” When you burn something it leaves ashes, but with this waster nothing remains. They show dramatic images, but the body does not survive that heat; whatever ash there is is blown into the atmosphere. You are totally gone.

And here is the beauty of it: God put it in their spirit to make that thing, and he is going to use that same thing to end them. The weapon they feel gave them their power, authority and respect, he will turn against them.

When Paul came to Corinth he “found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:)”. Rome commanded all the Israelites to leave. That is mass deportation, the same thing Claudius Caesar did back then that you see happening today with Trump and the ICE raids, and they are not raiding Europeans; they are going after the black and Hispanic communities.

But look what Aquila and Priscilla did after they were deported. They sailed with Paul into Syria, evangelizing and doing the work. When they heard Apollos, who only knew John, they “took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.” And Paul writes, “Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus: Who have for my life laid down their own necks”. That brother and his wife were not regular to Paul: they put their own heads on the chopping block for him.

The deportation was a divine mission. The Lord set them up to meet Paul, to teach Apollos, and to help spread the gospel. So don't be scared of no damn ICE. A man's going is of the Lord, and if they take your green card or your citizenship and send you back, it is of the Lord. Brother Nehemiah was deported from France for refusing to stop teaching, labelled an extremist, and now he is doing good in Ghana.

“But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.” Nothing can happen to you unless the Lord allows it. “And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.” Even the bad things happen for good, as the deportation did for Aquila and Priscilla. God has a purpose for every last one of us.

The fourth kingdom “shall be strong as iron” is Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. Strong as iron means strong militarily. But Daniel goes on: in the feet and toes, “part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”. They have that same military strength Rome had, yet “the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” Why broken? Because they are divided. That is what you see taking place right now: America is divided.

Christ said it: “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.” A lot of times we use this for when we were divided in Jerusalem, and it is. But it is also speaking of the last days, of the kingdom that is set up in the last days, and it tells us what happens before its destruction.

Read on: “If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?” Which kingdom is Satan's kingdom? Europe and America. America and Europe are divided; that alliance is falling apart. Here in America the citizens are divided. Satan is divided against himself, and that is a sign that they are about to fall. How can his kingdom stand? It can't.

The same division is prophesied of Egypt, and America is spiritually called Egypt: “I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” White people will be fighting white people, city against city, the same way the South fought against the North in the Civil War. The Lord is behind all of it.

So the iron kingdom of Daniel 2:40 is strong, but its own division is what brings it to desolation. The civil war things are already going on, even in the drawing of new districts between Texas and California to hold the House and the Senate. Pay attention: a house divided against a house falls.

“How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!” This Babylon is America, and the hammer of the whole earth is America, the oppressor. The same way the Lord used Nebuchadnezzar to judge Israel and all the nations, he uses America in these last days to beat all nations into subjection and bring judgment on them. America is no longer acting as Lucifer, the one about peace, justice and rights; it is turning back into who it really is, and it will oppress all nations, including Europe.

“Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand”. In whose hand? The Lord's. The Lord is the one using Babylon. Everything Babylon does, everything Trump is doing on the earth today, is because the Lord wants it done. “that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine”. That wine is oppression, affliction, falsehood, lies and deceit: the same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to make all nations drink.

“therefore the nations are mad.” Europe, China, Russia, Iran, the Arab nations, Venezuela: they are angry. America went into a sovereign country, took its leader, brought him back on drug charges and had four billion dollars' worth of oil shipped over. That is the cup, and Venezuela will not be the only one to drink it; even if they do not want to, the Lord will make them drink.

That is why the hammer will be greatly despised and broken. This is the beginning of sorrows; the world has changed and it is not going to get better. Prepare your mind and your spirit, and stop being caught up in sin.

“The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say”. The violence done to us, the Israelites, will be upon Babylon, and the Babylon here is America. But who is Zion, and where is Zion dwelling? Zechariah shows it is not just talking about the past, what Nebuchadnezzar did to us; it is talking about the future.

“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” The land of the north is America. Read on: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” And in Psalms 137 the daughter of Babylon is Edom. So Zion, the Israelites, is dwelling with white people in the land of the north, in America.

That means the violence in Jeremiah 51:35 is violence they will do to us in this land, and that blood will be upon them. Then: “Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee”. As we pray and ask him for vengeance and mercy, the Lord pleads our cause and takes vengeance on America for what they are doing to our people. So brothers, I know you are mad at what you see happening outside, but the Lord said he will take vengeance for us. “I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry. And Babylon shall become heaps”: a burnt heap.

Until then, Zion must deliver herself: stop the porn, the fornication and adultery, stop worshipping the white image of Christ, stop carrying grudges, hatred and envy, serve God and get right.

Jeremiah says, “And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land”. What is the rumour we will hear in the land? Christ answers it: “And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”. The rumour is war.

What kind of war? Not just rumours of war in Russia or the Middle East, but rumours of America having a civil war. “a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour”: one year you will hear there might be a civil war in America, and another year you will hear it again. Then “violence in the land, ruler against ruler.” There will be violence here in the land of America, and they will not just fight each other; they will kill us in this land too, those of us who teach the gospel.

Read on: “Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon”, the graven images of Christianity, “and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.” That is civil war taking place here in Babylon. That did not happen to ancient Babylon, which fell by a coup, not by that violence.

So before that day, the Lord says, “My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.” Deliver your soul: stop the porn, the fornication and adultery, stop worshipping the white image of Christ, stop carrying grudges, hatred and envy, serve God and get right, so your heart does not faint when the rumours come.

“But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.” Every hair on your head is numbered, so nothing can happen to you unless the Lord allows it. Don't be living and rolling in fear, and don't be scared of no damn ICE. A man's going is of the Lord. The spirit of Christ dwells in you; you are valuable.

Paul adds, “And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God.” If you love God, whatever happens, even bad things in your life, happens for good. When Aquila and Priscilla were deported, it was for good: they ended up as Paul's helpers teaching the gospel. God had a plan for them.

“To them who are the called according to his purpose.” Every last one of us is called according to God's purpose. None of us knows where our going is or what the Lord has planned for us, but he has a purpose for each of us.

A brother in France was told to stop teaching the word of God or leave. He would not stop, so they labelled him an extremist, refused to renew his papers, and deported him. Right now he is in Ghana, doing good, all praises to the Lord. So don't think papers, a green card or citizenship will protect you; laws are being set up to take them away from those who speak against America or Christianity. If they take your green card and send you back, it is what it is, of the Lord. Don't run, don't cry and lose your dignity; make preparation, and go over there and teach the word, because all things work together for good to them that love God.
