Solomon shows whose scale it is: “A just weight and balance are the Lord’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.” The just weight belongs to the Lord. So if you are dealing with a just weight and balance, you are in the spirit, and the Most High loves that.

The Most High is not a joke. He gives commandments on what you should do to live, and says keep them so that you may have life. Dealing justly with your brother is love, and “Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.” Doing back-dealing with your brother shows no love; that is hatred. By being covetous you break many laws.

That is why the just weight comes with a promise: “that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.” The scale that is the Lord's is the scale that lengthens your days.

“Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.” The great and the small that Deuteronomy forbids in the bag and in the house are both alike. If you are not doing the right dealings in your business, the Lord is looking at you as an abomination.

Eventually he is going to put your lights out, because he already warned you. If you want long life, have a just weight; that is the thing he is pleased in. If you have divers weights and divers measures, the Lord is not pleased, and your days are going to be short.

That is the other side of Deuteronomy 25:15. If a just weight lengthens your days, an unjust balance shortens them. One day somebody is going to realize you have been robbing them, and they are going to kill you. Dudes will kill you for a dollar; you would be surprised what people do. The Bible knows that, and the Lord wrote about it from the very beginning.

Had you been doing your four chapters a day and applying yourself, you would remember scriptures like this, and when the devil tried to tempt you, you would say no: the Bible says the Lord counts it an abomination.

“Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.” You feel good when you make that extra money from tilting the scale, when you are stealing. It tastes sweet.

“But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.” What he does not know is where it leads: death and condemnation. The one who eats the stolen bread is sitting among the dead.

So do not be a thief. Deal righteously; deal according to the law, statutes and commandments. The divers weights of Deuteronomy 25 are stolen waters, and the days they seem to add are really shortened, just as the law warned: the just weight is “that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.”

And pride keeps a man from hearing it: “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.” Once people have a little money in their pocket, they feel grown and will not seek counsel, and when everything falls apart, then they want counsel. The scriptures say blessed is he that readeth; if we apply what we read, we will be all right.

“Ye cannot serve God and mammon.” Mammon is money. That is why the elite do not want to hear anything about God: they feel like they are in their heaven already. And that is why a lot of people are scared of dying. Many times the fear of death is not death itself.

“O death, how bitter is the remembrance of thee to a man that liveth at rest in his possessions”. That man is living so good that the moment he thinks of death, he says, I have to leave all this behind? Because of his possessions his mind is on here. He is not thinking about the possession over there, what the Most High has in store for us that eyes have not seen and ears have not heard. He wants it now.

“Unto the man that hath nothing to vex him, and that hath prosperity in all things: yea, unto him that is yet able to receive meat!” Do you think a covetous man wants to die, after he just got that nice Porsche and bought that nice house? No. He needs to enjoy it a little more, because it is never enough to a covetous man.

That is why in this truth you cannot get attached to things. The saints love not their lives unto death. Nothing on this planet can hold us back from doing what we are supposed to be doing, and whatever is going to happen to us is what will happen; the apostles were appointed last, unto death. You cannot hold to money and serve God too.

“Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.” Why? Because of what you were supposed to do first: “Let reason go before every enterprize, and counsel before every action.” Everything you take on to do, you are supposed to seek counsel. And if you seek counsel and apply it, things are going to go well for you.

But instead of seeking counsel, pride kicks in. I am my own man, I do what I want. A lot of times when brothers have bad dealings with each other, both of them were out of the spirit, because neither one ever asked for counsel: Listen, I want to do this job with so-and-so; what do you think about it?

Once people have a little money in their pocket, they feel grown. I own my own house, I bought it with my own money, I am doing better than you; who are you to counsel me? Then months later, years later, when everything falls apart, now they want counsel. Counsel did not go before that enterprise; pride went before it, and destruction came with it.

You need counsel before, not after. That is why we have to remember the scriptures: blessed is he that readeth, and if we apply what we read, we are going to be all right. Reason and counsel before every action is the cure for the pride that goes before destruction.
blog/2026/2026-02-14-2026-02-14-fighting:
“Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.” Satan does not run around doing his own thing. He goes before the Lord and answers to him.

“And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.” That walking up and down in the earth is the dust he eats. In Genesis 3 God said, “upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life”. Here is that judgment being lived out: his job is to walk the earth to see whom he can tempt and destroy. Satan became the tempter, and that is his judgment; soon he will be destroyed.

It happened after Satan was judged, and it shows the order of things. The power of this world was delivered to him, but he still presents himself before the Lord and reports where he has been.

The word Satan comes from a Hebrew term meaning adversary: accuser, opponent. And the word devil means deceiver. He is the Lord’s adversary and our adversary. And not only the spiritual Satan: his seed, his children, are our adversary too, because God put enmity between his seed and her seed. The so-called white man is our adversary, and the spiritual demon Satan is our adversary. That is the war we are in.

Satan made his move on Adam through the weaker vessel, and God brought judgment on the serpent, the woman and the man. To the serpent: “Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field”. That is not about livestock. This is paradise; he is cursed above every creation God made there. And, “upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life”.

That one line says two things. Man was made from the earth, and Satan is a celestial being, so “all the days of thy life” means his days are numbered: he will be destroyed in the future for what he did. And eating dust means he is on the earth, and the Lord handed him power over it.

Luke shows it: “the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” When was the power of this earth delivered to Satan? In Genesis 3, what we just read.

And he gave it to whom he would: first to Cain, and then to Esau, the so-called white man in these last days. That is why Esau is able to create all this technology.

Then comes the declaration of war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. Back then her seed was Abel, then Seth and the chosen lineage, and Satan’s seed was Cain and his descendants. Today her seed is the twelve tribes of Israel, and his seed is the so-called Caucasians, Edom. And “it shall bruise thy head”, because his seed, the Romans, crucified Christ. Then, “and thou shalt bruise his heel”: the Lord will take down Satan and his children. So when the Bible says to be soldiers of Jesus Christ, we fight Satan, his wicked thoughts and whispers, and we also fight his children, his physical counterpart.

When did the war start? Through the envy of the devil, when he made his move on Adam’s kingdom. And he made that move through Adam’s wife: “Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made.”

The serpent is Satan, the devil. It says serpent, but it is not talking about a snake; he is called a serpent because he is slick, forked-tongued, tricky. And notice, “which the Lord God had made.” God created him to be exactly who he is. He was subtil because God made him subtil.

Job confirms it: “By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.” God formed that crooked serpent, Satan. He is not a rival power that rose up on his own to equal God; he is a creature God made, crooked by design.

So Satan tricked Eve, the weaker vessel, and caused her to sin, and Eve went and convinced her husband to sin. Then the Most High came to deal with Adam, Eve and Satan, and brought judgment on all three. From there God declared the war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”.

That is why we have to know our adversary. The serpent that deceived Eve is the same one we fight today, in his whispers and in his children, and the one who formed him is the one who will judge him.

Genesis 4 shows Satan’s children being born in the earth. Eve bare Cain and then Abel; Abel kept sheep and Cain tilled the ground. “And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth”. The Lord told him, “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.” Do good and you will be accepted; do evil and Satan will rule over you. Cain would become the child of Satan and serve him.

Then Cain talked with Abel, “and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him”. That is the fulfillment of Genesis 3:15, “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. The enmity started there. Cain, Satan’s seed, killed our forefather: the first murder on the earth and the first blood shed in the war.

John proves Cain was that seed: “Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.” Cain was always evil. His descendants were the children of the devil, and they corrupted everyone on the earth, even the sons of God, until God destroyed the world. All the evil you see Esau doing on the earth today, Cain was doing back then.

Then the sons of God and the sons of the devil came back. Rebekah’s children “struggled together within her”, and the Lord said, “Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels”. Jacob is the twelve tribes, the so-called Negroes and Hispanics; Esau is the so-called white man. This fight did not start with slavery, Jim Crow or civil rights; it started in the beginning with Cain and Abel, and was reborn as Jacob and Esau: good against evil. Many of our people followed Cain then, and many follow Esau now and have become children of the devil themselves.

Esau “came out red, all over like an hairy garment”, born without pigment, as Cain lost his when the earth cursed him. Jacob took hold on his heel, a prophetic sign of Genesis 3:15: our Lord coming to destroy Satan and his children. And when scripture says “the devil shall cast some of you into prison”, it was Herod, an Edomite, who “killed James the brother of John with the sword” and took Peter. The devil means the deceiver, and it is interchangeable: the father and his children, who can do nothing without the father that dwells in them.

Job ends where chapter 32 began. There the three men ceased to answer him “because he was righteous in his own eyes”, and Elihu was angry “because he justified himself rather than God.” Here Job says, “I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee. Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

Job hated himself and repented. He repented for justifying himself and not God, for being righteous in his own eyes. He had said, I am righteous, this is not supposed to happen to me; I made a covenant with mine eyes, I don't look at other women, I am not weak like Adam, I don't hide sin in my bosom. That was his flaw. He was over-righteous, and the Lord did not like it.

In his own eyes Job did not look at it as though there was a reason God was doing this, that God was trying to make him better. In his mind it was, I am righteous, I am not like this person or that person. So the Bible says, “Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?” That person who tries to act over-righteous just ends up looking fake; nobody knows everything and nobody is perfect.

This is the war within, the war nobody sees. Everything Job suffered before was physical, but Satan was attacking his mind too. The Lord used what Job went through to show him what was inside himself, and that is what Satan's attacks do: they show you things inside yourself. Through all of it Job was made perfect, and he came out of it repenting in dust and ashes, justifying God instead of himself.

Christ said evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders and the rest come “from within, out of the heart of men”, and “defile the man.” So how do those evil things get into your mind? Remember who the war is against: Satan. Acts shows how he does it.

“But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession, And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet. But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost” What did Satan do? He filled his heart to lie. That lying spirit comes from Satan.

That is how he works. He is there in your head, whispering thoughts, tempting you, putting things there that are not there. The deacon says something to you and Satan says, why did he say that to you? The deacon don't like you. A husband gives his wife an order to clean the bathroom, and Satan whispers: you going to let him talk to you like that, after all you do in this house? He don't understand you; he don't love you. If she listens, she becomes bitter and it shows in her actions.

Satan puts things in everyone's head, the deacon included. The fight with Satan starts first and foremost in your mind, and many fall in this truth because they wait until the mind is already defiled. To win, you have to kill it right there: the thoughts Satan puts in your mind should never become action. Ask, why am I thinking like this? Fast and pray, Lord take these thoughts out of my mind, and answer him with the word of God, “the sword of the Spirit”, the weapon we fight with.
blog/2026/2026-02-14-2026-02-14-prepare-:
“Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry”. That is in the New Testament, for you black Christians, you black apologists, you black pastors who say the law is done away with. Why would Paul write it if the law was done away? Because it goes right back to Exodus 20: “Thou shalt have no other gods before me”.

“Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”. That is where 1 Corinthians 10:14 comes from.

Valentine's Day is idolatry; its origin is Februus and Lupercalia, a fertility rite in which women presented themselves to be struck because it was believed to help with fertility. When you sit up there and celebrate Valentine's Day, you are putting Februus, whoever the hell that is, and Lupercalia before the Lord. What's wrong with Christmas? It's idolatry. Your birthday? Idolatry. Halloween? Idolatry. That's what's wrong with it.

The Lord gave us our own high holy days, in Leviticus 23. The Destruction of Nicanor began last night at sundown, the victory recorded in 1 Maccabees 7 and 2 Maccabees 14 and 15, when Judas Maccabeus defeated and killed Nicanor, the Seleucid Syrian Greek commander who came to crush Israel and threaten the temple. Tonight at sundown begins Purim, when we were saved from being wiped out in the Persian Empire: the enemy was Haman, and the deliverance came through Esther and Mordecai. Our enemies' holidays, the Fourth of July and Christmas, are victories over us. Ours are victories over our enemies. Flee from their idolatry and keep what the Lord gave us.

“His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark.” We are supposed to watch and pray, to be alert to the times, to keep our spirit in order with the Most High and to repent. But the watchmen are blind. All these Christian apologists and Black pastors are ignorant. We are on the brink of civil war in America, and how many pastors are saying prepare ye war? None of them. They are celebrating Valentine's Day. They cannot bark: they will not prophesy and they will not warn you, like the dog that jumped out the window when its own owner pretended to break into the house.

They are “sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber”, silent and lazy, and “greedy dogs which can never have enough.” One pastor said nobody leaves until he gets his 40 G's, lock the doors. Another said sow a seed of ten thousand and you'll be a millionaire overnight. All they speak about is prosperity: nothing about prophecy, nothing about warning you, nothing about getting your spirit right. Many don't even think they have a reason to bark, because they are too comfortable to see the danger right in front of them.

Here is one of the watchmen in action. Jamal Bryant, senior pastor of New Birth Missionary Baptist Church, preached with conviction that 85% of Jesus's life he was wrong and out of order, doing what he was not called to do, and the people sat there and listened to it.

The Bible says sin is the transgression of the law, the breaking and violating of God's laws. So was Christ wrong? Peter answers: “Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth.” He did no wrong at all.

Yet a pastor will get up and speak against Christ, and you never hear him speak against Babylon, America, never against homosexuality, never against the idolatrous festivals out here. That is the blind watchman, the dumb dog that cannot bark. So the prophets have to go out and proclaim among the Gentiles, “Prepare war”, and our own people need to know war is coming too.

Christ said to watch and pray, “for ye know not when the time is.” Peter says the same: “But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.” Be sober, man. Keep a clear mind.

“And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.” Fervent charity is the brotherly love we are supposed to have for one another, the way we are supposed to treat one another.

We need it because these things are taking place, and we see them taking place on the earth. The end of all things is at hand, so watching and praying goes together with a clear mind and with love among ourselves.

Watching and praying is not only for the nation at large. “Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving”. Watch and pray for your household, your children, your brothers and sisters, because if the house fails, the nation gets weaker.

That is why marriage classes keep coming up. The scripture says it is not good for man to be alone. Some brothers think they are strong enough to do it without her, but it is not good that you should be alone; two are better than one.

And watch in the same with thanksgiving: be thankful for the things you have right now, because some people are in a way worse position than you. So continue in prayer, be thankful, and keep preparing, because you do not know when the time is.

“Take ye heed, watch and pray”, and Christ tells us what to watch and pray for: “Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.”

Watch and pray for the destruction of their wicked devices: that the traps, the plots and the lies of the enemy be exposed and broken. Ask the Most High to show you.

Pray for prophecy to be fulfilled. And pray that you are worthy to stand before Christ when these things come. We see all this unfolding, the nations moving and the empire declining, so the prayer is not for these things to be stopped but for us to be found worthy to escape them and stand before the Son of man.

Christ said, “Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.” You don't know when the time is coming, so you need to stay prepared, stay ready. The prophecy is unfolding before our eyes: the ten horns giving their kingdoms to the beast, NATO sending weapons and troops here and there, and a time coming when those horns will hate the whore.

So what do we pray for? David shows us: “Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.” Watch and pray for protection and deliverance, asking the Lord to fight against them that fight against us.

Watch and pray that none of us drift, get isolated, or get taken by sin and deception. You can pray for that. These Black Christians don't know what to pray for, but the scripture shows you: pray for the Lord to plead our cause against them that strive with us.
blog/2026/2026-02-14-2026-02-14-the-iran:
The Iranians burned large statues of a horned, bull-headed figure bearing the so-called Star of David, and they knew what they were doing: they were burning statues of Baal. That is not the Star of David. You cannot find it anywhere in the Bible; it is a sign in the occult.

Stephen said, “Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.” If you didn't know, Moloch is Baal: the same thing, both the devil. The star is the star of their god, the devil, Baal or Moloch.

Stephen was quoting Amos: “But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.” Which ye made to yourselves: it is idolatry. God did not give us that star. When King Solomon was dabbling in witchcraft, that is how he got that star; God never gave it to us.

So the star so-called Israel and America carry is the star of Baal, and Baal worship shows up in plain sight: the bull's head statue at the 1933 Chicago World's Fair on Jewish Day, the giant mechanical bull at the 2022 Commonwealth Games, the bull on Wall Street. Even bullheaded, stupidly stubborn, comes from Baal worship, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. That idolatry is why Israel was carried away, and why we are in captivity today.

The second beast is “like to a bear”, and the bear is the Persians and the Medes. “it raised up itself on one side”: Persia raised itself up, because through King Cyrus, Persia became mightier than Media. “and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. What three nations do those ribs represent? Isaiah 45:14 answers: “Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans”. The three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, the nations Persia conquered.

This kingdom of Persia and Media is very significant for what is going on today. The Achaemenid Empire of Old Persian was an ancient Iranian empire, founded by Cyrus the Great in 550 BC. The bear of Daniel 7 is Iran.

And the Lord worked through that Persian king. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.” The Lord spoke to him, and he listened. Isaiah says of him, “He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.” And the chapter of the three ribs opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”.

So the Lord used King Cyrus, a Persian, to let us go back and build the temple, and gave him Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans to devour. That is why the bear rose up on one side, and why the land of Persia, Iran, stands in prophecy for the days we are in.

Ezra foretold that “the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” The Carmanians are the Iranians: Carmania was a region of southeastern Iran, the modern province of Kerman, part of the Persian Empire, and Persia only formally became Iran in 1935. Why the Assyrians? In antiquity Assyria conquered Israel, took the northern kingdom, and moved into our land. That is exactly what Esau-Edom has done with our land today. They are not the rightful inhabitants; they are thieves, and the Lord is against them.

Ezekiel says so: “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”. Who is Mount Seir? “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So the prophecy is against Esau-Edom, and the Lord says, “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.”

Why? “Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. The two nations are the northern kingdom, Ephraim, and the southern kingdom, Judah: they took those two nations by identity theft, robbing us of who we are. The two countries are the United States of America and Israel. The children of Israel were in both first, and the whole world was made for our sake, but Edom stole both lands.

They said, “and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there”. They possess it as if the Lord were with them, by calling themselves Jews and Christians. So “I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.” The same way they hate the Israelites, the so-called Blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans, the Lord will use that same anger against them, and they will know that God did it.

Christ names them too: “I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” He knows our poverty, “but thou art rich”, because the promises and the covenant belong to us.

Cyrus the Great founded the Achaemenid Empire, the old Persian kingdom, in 550 BC, and it was an ancient Iranian empire. That makes this very significant for what is going on today. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem”.

The Lord was working through King Cyrus. The Lord did speak to him, and he listened. Isaiah had already named him: “That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.”

So the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah was fulfilled through a Persian, an Iranian king, called by God his shepherd, who performed all his pleasure: Jerusalem built again and the foundation of the temple laid.

Isaiah goes on: “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut”.

That is why Cyrus could say, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth”. The Lord held his right hand and subdued nations before him. The Lord used King Cyrus, who was a Persian, to allow us to go back and build the temple.

Cyrus is also the one who gave that decree. And the kingdom he ruled, Persia and Media, is Iran today, which is why his story is very significant for what is going on now.

Hosea says the Lord “shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.” The west is the western hemisphere, where the tribes are primarily scattered.

Isaiah says the same: “Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west”. The Lord gathers his children from where they are, and the west is where most of them are, here in America and this side of the world.

So when the Lord roars, the children who tremble and walk after him come from the west, and he gathers them. That is the hope for the tribes over here, but it comes with a warning. Before this the class read that Babylon's “sins have reached unto heaven”, and that we must come out of the ways of America and out of her idolatry. If we don't repent of our stubbornness, our bullheadedness and our idolatry, we will get the same judgment as her. The seed that is gathered from the west is the seed that answers the roar and walks after the Lord.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country”. The children who tremble from the west in Hosea are the ones the Lord saves from the west country. “And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

Remember what the Jewish Encyclopedia said earlier in the class about Arzareth: the land beyond the great river, far from the habitation of man, where the ten tribes of Israel would dwell observing the laws of Moses until the time of the restoration, and Columbus identified America with that land. It was prophesied that we would be over here until the time of restoration. This is that restoration: the Lord bringing us from the west country to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem.

And it is “in truth and in righteousness”. That is why the class closed on idolatry: “the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil”, and our stubbornness and disdain for God's commandments are idolatry. Flee from idolatry, so that you are among the people he brings back.

“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.” Think of a pancake: the top is white and the bottom is brown. We still have that, but you have a lot of light skin, and it was strategic. The whitening campaigns across Latin America were a war on blackness, meant to make us forget our heritage: grandmothers praising good hair and light babies, textbooks erasing black heroes, children taught not to embrace their nose, their lips or their skin. That is how you colonize a people from the inside out. This devil is very evil and very strategic, but there is a God.

“Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The pleasant place is the island of Puerto Rico. Ephraim and Manasseh are Joseph. “Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.”

A lot of misinformed and uneducated people think the northern kingdom is not Israel just because they are light-skinned. No. The Lord knows exactly who they are, and the Lord made sure the seed would continue. It doesn't matter if they are light or dark; the Lord knows who is who, just as he knew that Asher would land in Brazil, and Brazil is Hebrew for iron. The Lord didn't make a mistake.

So the cake not turned is still Ephraim. Mixed among the people and whitened on top, brought forth to the murderer in a pleasant place, the northern kingdom is still the children of Israel, and the curses on them prove it.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” This is what Lucifer does, what the beast does. Iran has not forgotten what America did, and God has not forgotten what America is doing in the earth right now and all the evil it has done before. The Lord is saying America will have its demise, because of all the evil it is doing on the earth.

“Which didst weaken the nations”: they have Cuba on its knees right now, and those are our brothers and sisters over there. Trump threatened tariffs on any country that sells oil to Cuba, said there will be no more oil or money going to Cuba, zero, and put pressure on Mexico until Mexico pulled away. Then he says Cuba looks ready to fall. Why is it ready to fall? Because you are causing it, Trump. It is the same thing they did to Iran, and to Venezuela. This is what they do everywhere they go.

Ezra names that beast: “Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?” Esau is the fourth beast, and he is going to bring the end of the times; you can see why.

“And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression.” Power over the whole compass of the earth, with much wicked oppression: that is America weakening the nations, and that is why it will be cut down to the ground.

“For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name”. That is what you see now: what is happening with Venezuela, with Cuba, with ICE here in America, and now the US sending troops to Nigeria. The Lord is bringing evil upon his people first. “and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth”. If the Lord is judging us, understand that the judgment of the nations is soon to come.

But if we do not get rid of the idolatry, the same judgment America gets, we would get. So the voice from heaven says, “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Come out of the ways of America. Come out of the idolatry.

“For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.” Edom thinks God has forgotten. The Lord remembers every last iniquity, every atrocity, every abomination they have committed. “Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.”

So if we do not repent of the stubbornness, the bullheadedness and the idolatry, we will get the same judgment. That is why we keep hitting these streets, blitzing, travelling and doing the work of the Lord to wake our people up and bring them out of her.

Jeremiah says the Lord's device is against Babylon “to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the Lord, the vengeance of his temple.” The Lord has not forgotten what the Romans did to our temple under Titus and Vespasian, and the Romans today are the United States of America, the same people. They thought that God forgot.

David shows it: “These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself”. The Lord is patient and longsuffering. Because he kept silence, they thought he forgot what they did to our temple, as if he were like them.

Then: “but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.” The Lord will reprove them, and that is what he is doing in these last days: setting things in order before their eyes, and there is nothing they can do about it.

That is why “the Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes”, the Iranians. The Lord put this mindset in them, always to be against Babylon, the United States of America. “Make bright the arrows; gather the shields”: those arrows are the ICBMs, the nukes, the bombs. They are not scared and they are not backing down, because the vengeance of his temple has not been forgotten.

Judges says Israel “served Baalim” and “forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt”. Hosea shows how ungrateful that was: “For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.”

That is what the Lord did for Israel. He clothed us, gave us land, gave us food and possessions, all of that. And we turned around and prepared it for Baal; we started serving the devil with what God gave us. Baal, Baalim, it is the same thing: the Canaanite god of fertility, storms, thunder and lightning, worshipped in horrible ways, whose name means lord or master. He sounds like Thor. Baal and Ashtaroth have taken on so many names over the ages, which is why we rarely hear of them, but the worship is coming back to light.

Even now it goes on. Just days before this class, thousands of Afro-Brazilians gathered on a Rio beach to offer gifts to a sea goddess, Yemanja, revered in the Yoruba religion as the mother of all orishas and humanity. Brazil is the tribe of Asher. It is the same deity all throughout: “the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven”. Ashtaroth, the queen of heaven, Yemanja, whatever the name. Our people carried that witchcraft with them and kept doing it, even in Africa.

That's our history, and that is why we are in captivity today, catching hell. The Lord clothed us and named us, yet even in 2026 our people are still worshipping the devil, and we wonder why America goes down there stealing presidents, starving people out and destabilizing countries.

“And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.” Molech worship went along with the fertility gods: it dealt with children, with the womb. That is what we were doing, and it is exactly what God told us not to do. We became bullheaded and stubborn and started worshipping the devil. That is how Israel “forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.”

Stubbornness runs through this whole history. “A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.” So we have to prophesy against the idolatry and come up out of this foolishness: Christmas, Valentine's Day, which a lot of our people celebrated. It has nothing to do with us. God did not give it to us.

“Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn”. That is why God's laws are taught without going to the left or the right: we know how we got over here, through stubbornness. If we want to be delivered, we have to wake up.

It is how Israel gets down: “when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.” When there is no judge, no leader, in place, they go back to their lonesome: the officer's not here, the captain's not here, the Deacon's not here, the Bishop ain't here. If you can't uphold righteousness when nobody is looking, the same judgment is your future. Stubborn goes back to bullheaded, and bullheaded goes back to Baal.

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.” Stubbornness is idolatry; it is satanic worship. So many think they are not dabbling in the mystic arts, but when you are stubborn and rebellious, you are: “sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone”.

Judges 2:19 ends: “they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.” Stubborn goes back to bullheaded, and bullheaded goes back to Baal. 1 Samuel 15:23 says what stubbornness really is.

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.” Bullheaded, stubborn, is idolatry. It is satanic worship.

That is how Israel gets down: “when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers.” Whenever there is not a judge, a leader, in place, they go to their lonesome. They get relaxed: the officer is not here, the captain is not here, the deacon is not here, the bishop ain’t here, let’s go back to our lonesome. If that is your spirit, you are going to get the same judgment. If you can’t uphold righteousness when nobody is looking, that is your future: damnation, judgment, destruction.

Ecclesiasticus 30:12, read just before, gives the remedy: “Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn.” That is why God’s laws are taught without going to the left or to the right, and without playing games. We know how we got over here: through stubbornness. So if we want to get delivered, we have to wake the hell up.

1 Samuel 15:23 said rebellion is as witchcraft and stubbornness is as idolatry. Revelation 21:8 shows where the witches and the idolaters end up.

“But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone.”

A lot of y’all think, I’m not dabbling in the mystic arts. Yes, you are. When you are stubborn and rebellious, yes, you are. It says sorcerers and idolaters. The one who in Judges 2:19 would not cease “from their stubborn way” is standing with the sorcerers and the idolaters, and their part is the lake of fire.

Psalms 78:8 makes the connection plain: “a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright.” “The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle. They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law.” That is the northern kingdom, though Judah did the same thing. Even when they got over here to the Americas they still did not keep the covenant, and that is why Assyria took the northern kingdom and why Columbus and Cortez came: because of the idolatry. The Lord was sick of it and still is, and this is the last time.

Romans 4:4 says “Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.” To him that offers sacrifices, the reward is not reckoned of grace or mercy, but of debt, because under Moses there was no grace. Hebrews shows it: “He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses”. Without mercy means without grace.

If you chose to do something worthy of death that an animal could not atone for, you had to die. If you broke the Sabbath, you couldn't atone with an animal. Homosexuality, you couldn't atone with an animal. Idolatry, you couldn't atone with an animal. And if you chose not to sacrifice at all, you had to die. So you were indebted to offer continual sacrifices all the time: continual burnt offerings, drink offerings, sin offerings.

The prophets said the temple would be destroyed. Once the temple is gone, where are your works? If your salvation rests on sacrificing an animal and there is no animal, no priest and no temple to atone with, by default you have condemned yourself. That is why faith in Christ has to supersede the works.

“But to him that worketh not”, him that does not offer sacrifice, “but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.” Christ justifies the ungodly through his death. Just as with Abraham, who was counted faithful before he sacrificed animals, God “imputeth righteousness without works”. Israel could keep sacrificing while the temple stood, but Christ had to come first in their minds, or they were in debt.

Romans 4:2 says “For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.” What works is Paul talking about? Nehemiah condenses them into one verse: “For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.”

Continual means it was done all the time, daily, annually. And “to make an atonement” goes back to the word justify: atone, justify and reconcile are the same thing. So the works Paul is talking about are temple sacrifice, temple law. When Paul wrote, the temple was still standing and the Jews in Rome were still going to it and still sacrificing, and they believed their works were enough.

Abraham shows the order. In Genesis 15 the Lord promised the old man an heir out of his own bowels and seed as the stars, “And he believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness.” He was promised the land and he believed. Only then was he told to take the heifer, the goat, the ram and the birds and divide them. Faith came first, then the works.

When brothers don't study Paul's letters, they start saying Paul's letters are not authoritative, and speak evil of dignities, of Paul, Mark and Luke, because they weren't of the twelve. When you speak evil of dignities, your mind is blinded and you end up teaching a whole different gospel: that the nations can be saved. House negroes are the worst kind of negro. But this is the college course of this school. Know what the works are from Nehemiah, and nobody can come to your school or camp and confound you at Romans 4.

Romans 5:11 says “by whom we have now received the atonement”, and the margin gives the word reconciliation. Atonement is Christ’s death, which brings us back to the Father. Reconcile in verse 10 and atonement in verse 11 are the same word; that is also called adoption. Atonement is reparation for a wrong or injury: when Christ died on the cross he died for our wrongs. Break the word down in English and it is at-onement: bringing back together again as one. Who did God come to bring together as one? Israel, the two sticks joined together, both kingdoms.

So who was the atonement ever made for? “But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.” For Israel. Not for everybody.

The theology of the world says atonement is the reconciliation of God and all humankind. But God was never one with all humankind. All nations were never one with Israel, ever. The priesthood of Aaron made atonement for one people, and when Christ made the atonement with his own body, he made it for that same people.

In the days of Hezekiah, “they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.”

All means all twelve, because Hezekiah was trying to bring them back together: all twelve tribes, and the strangers that showed up for the Passover.

Here reconciliation and atonement stand side by side, and they were made through the blood of animals. When Christ died, his body replaced them. That is why Romans 5:9 says “being now justified by his blood”: his blood replaces the animals, the works we no longer receive justification from. And the time came, as Daniel 9 foretold, when the temple was destroyed, the priests scattered abroad and not one stone left standing. With no way left to atone with animals, we had to have faith in Christ; otherwise you condemn yourself, indebted to a law you can no longer keep.

So atonement, reconciliation and justification are three words for the same thing, for the same people, with the same God. Reconciliation is the restoration of a friendly relationship, a reuniting; you cannot reunite with someone you were never joined to. Israel was with God before, rebelled until “he was turned to be their enemy”, and through the death of his Son was brought back again. That is Romans 5:10: “when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son”.

“But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.” Christ came and died for his people; he was cut off for his people. Romans 5:9 says we are “justified by his blood”, and Ephesians says it is that same blood that brings near those who were far off.

“For he is our peace, who hath made both one”. That is the peace of Romans 5:1, “we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ”. And it shows who is being spoken of. Who is the both? The two nations. When you read the history in the book of Kings, Israel and Judah split apart into two kingdoms, and Ezekiel prophesied that our king would come and die for the nation of Israel and the nation of Judah, so that they would no longer be two nations but one nation under Christ.

He “hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us; Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace”. What was two is now one new man, with no more division.

“And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross”. That is the same word as Romans 5:10, “we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son”. Reconcile means to bring together again, and the both being reconciled are the southern and northern kingdoms. So the audience in Romans is the same people God spoke to in the old covenant: the Jews in the church at Rome, and with them the Gentiles, who are the northern kingdom. Christ, by his death, brought both houses back to the Father as one.

To covet is not simply to desire. It is to want what belongs to another inordinately: you violate God's laws to get it. “Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s”. The daughter belongs under the father just like everything else in his house. Go around him to get her, never telling the fathers or the elders, and you have coveted. To entice is to allure, to bait, to induce to evil; it is trickery and deception. “My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not”. And “Love worketh no ill to his neighbour”: if you love the sister, how did you use ill means to get her?

Peter shows what we are supposed to be doing instead: “Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust. And beside this, giving all diligence”.

As brothers and sisters come in here, you are supposed to be escaping these worldly elements and truly repenting. When you look across the aisle, you are supposed to be looking for righteousness, not just her behind. Taking your sister for lust is the corruption that is in the world, and the same thing goes on on the other side. A man who talks to you under cover, without your father and without the leadership, does not have good intentions; the fact that he didn't do it the right way shows you where his mind is.

Do it with diligence, the right way. When we announce our marriages we say, this is the day the Lord has made between you two; you can bring forth righteousness right here, and the Lord, the angels and everybody are in agreement with it. When you do things the right way, you have a whole community behind you. The fathers and the elders have the vantage point: we see down the road where it is going, and we make the decision as fathers.

Exodus 22:17: “If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins”. He has to pay, but he still is not getting the daughter. Somebody might say, he paid, so he gets to take her. Leviticus 6 shows the principle: “Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away”.

Took violently away. To entice that daughter against her father's wishes is to violate him, and violation is violence. That is the same reason a man who steals an ox must “restore five oxen for an ox”: the owner was violated, and restitution is paid for the violent act against him.

“or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten”. The recent matter was deceit. Her fathers didn't know anything about it, the leadership didn't know anything about it, nobody knew until her sister discovered it, and they still weren't going to say anything. How are you going to come up later saying, here's the law?

“Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering”. The principal is the actual thing taken, and the fifth part is added on top. So you are not getting the daughter, and you still have to pay the fathers. That is why the judgment goes forward: we will not leave that kind of example for the rest of the sisters, to be beguiled by a wicked brother who says we're applying Exodus 22:16. That's a damn lie.

The Pharisees came to Christ “tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?” They were trying to use Moses' law, the writing of divorcement in Deuteronomy 24. Christ took them back to the beginning: “Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female, And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?” From the beginning there was no such thing as divorce. What are you talking about, quoting Moses? It's the same as a negro trying to quote Exodus 22:16.

“Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder”. God did not put these backdoor marriages together. That's why love worketh no ill to his neighbour: you will not do evil and call yourself love. You don't love anything but your own lust.

“Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away? He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so”. The only reason Moses had to bring in that negro-proof law is that we were hard-headed and gave Moses hell. It is a failsafe law, a kind of bylaw to keep us from going all the way wicked. You are not supposed to be in failure at all for it even to come up, and quoting one after you went off and did wrong does not make you righteous.

That is covering violence with the garment: “for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the Lord of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously”. The Pharisees enlarged the borders of their garments, and the fringes represent the laws. A man who deceived to get a sister and then gives her a so-called law from the Bible is covering his violation with the law. Sisters and brothers, watch yourselves, hold yourselves in the diligence of the scriptures, and stop playing games.

Habakkuk said, “I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower”. The watchman on the tower sees what the people below cannot. Peter gives the elders that charge: “Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof”.

Listen to the wording: taking the oversight. The leaders stand at a vantage point the flock cannot see. From the experience and the level they have reached over their years in the truth, they see what younger men and younger women do not, and God gave them revelation through the scriptures to see how to guide you. If we believe there is a God, and that Christ is the brain of this whole operation, then we are supposed to trust the men he set up.

But a lot of brothers and sisters in the congregation get horny and antsy and will not follow the counsel. Then they end up asking the same leadership whose oversight they did not trust to counsel them on the matter after the fact. That is completely backwards, and nobody does that but us. That is the negro mind.

“Not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind”. That is for the leadership: they feed the flock willingly and take the oversight because they love their people. Nobody is getting paid to do this. They do it of a ready mind, watching from the tower until the vision the Lord appointed comes.

Habakkuk stood on his tower demanding answers: how long are we going to be in this captivity? The Lord answered, “the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come”. Now that we know what time we are in, Isaiah says, “Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.”

Be men and use your mind. God gave the sons of God a mind to envision greatness, to see things in the mind before the hands build them. He gave you that vantage point so you can set up a congregation and make sure evil does not come among the brothers and sisters. O ye transgressors: change.

“I am God, and there is none like me, Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done”. God declared the end before he said, Let there be light. Everything falls in the path he wants it to fall. He knew from ancient times that the fourth bird from the mother hen would fly over Wyoming on March 7th, 2028. You say that bird is insignificant; he says, I need that bird to do that because it is connected to something else you don't know about. That is his vantage point.

“Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country”. While he causes that bird to come from the east, he calls another man to execute his judgment. “I have purposed it, I will also do it.” A sparrow shall not fall to the ground unless the Most High causes it. Everything is under his auspices; he knows why he holds the armies back so the earth is not destroyed. You and I are not on that level, and we try to move God while we will not keep the commandments. The only thing we need to do is obey what he said.

That is why the vision will not lie. We cannot reason out why he calls that insignificant raven, but in God's overall plan it is necessary, and the end he declared from the beginning will surely come.

Habakkuk was told, “the just shall live by his faith”, by the words of the book of our fathers. Isaiah shows what that faith requires of us: “Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.”

Those of us in wickedness must forsake it, and forsake the unrighteous thoughts of lasciviousness, lust, adultery and fornication. Get that thing out of your mind. He will pardon us if we are sincere, not pretending while on the back end doing evil and thinking nobody sees. The Lord understands the heartbeat of a raven, how many times a bird's heart will beat its whole life, and you think he don't see your black ass? You are playing with death.

“For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways”. Looking down from heaven on the whole planet, he sees everything we cannot. Our only vantage point is our immediate circumference, and we cannot take that and tell the Lord what to do.

It works the same in the congregation. A manager of a department sees his space; the leadership over all the departments sees the interactions between them, and why something is happening here and not there. Leaders are in front to protect the flock because they see the danger you do not see. The man on the tower sees it coming and sounds the trumpet with a certain sound, so the people know what to prepare for.

“So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please”. As the rain waters the earth and does not return void, everything the Lord sends has a purpose. So when leadership says, brother, leave the sister alone, or sister, leave the brother alone, there is a vantage point you do not see, and if you will not hear it, it gets revealed in judgment after you done laid with the dude. Follow the steps, betrothal and the whole nine, and the council can bless the wedding and counsel the trouble in the flesh. Say to hell with all of it, and you are saying you have nothing to do with us.

We say give the Lord no rest, make the time short, bring it on: when is he coming to get us out? We are trying to speed the Lord up. But the Lord has his timetable and a reason for the pace he is moving at, and when it is time for him to move, you can't stop it. Esau won't be able to stop it. “Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off.” When all the planets have lined up, it is time to send Christ and the destroying angels to bring his people home, and if you are not ready, he comes as a thief in the night.

Ezra shows the mind of the Most High, his vantage point: “Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together, Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot” … “before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure.”

“Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.” The Most High made all of that, so we can't question that kind of understanding. We are not on the level to question how the Lord did things. Nobody did this but him, and by him alone it shall be ended.

So he sends Christ when he is ready to send Christ. We don't know the day or the hour, but we know we are in the season, and the enemies of the Lord include some of our own people siding with the oppressors by agreeing to be in sin and destroying their own people. That is not the agencies; that is negroes being wicked as hell, and negro is a mind state across all twelve tribes that was never supposed to be you. Knowing these things are coming, we need to get our minds and our spirits right.

God's vantage point is far beyond the vantage point we think we have. People try to tell the Lord what to do: you can't love Jacob, you can't hate Esau, you can't forgive this one. So the Lord clears the deck and lets everybody know where he stands, and everybody else needs to shut the hell up.

“Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him?” Nobody. These are questions for us who are trying to push him. The dumb Christian talks about the way the Lord should be; shut up. “With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?” Who taught God knowledge? Nobody. God is the knowledge; how are you going to teach him?

Having asked questions we can't answer, he proclaims what it is: “Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket.” You walk with a pail of water and one drop falls out; you won't even notice it. All the nations put together are that one drop. They “are counted as the small dust of the balance”: not big dust, small dust on the scales, weighing nothing. “He taketh up the isles as a very little thing”: the Polynesian and Hawaiian islands, very little, nothing.

“And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.” If they burnt up all the meat in Lebanon, it would not be sufficient for him to accept the Arabs, Ishmael, as his people. That is the lesson for us. There are spirits in an unseen realm communicating through our minds. You cannot stop a thought from coming, but agreeing with it and acting on it is your choice. America is Satan's stage; everyone acts in the play, but you choose which script you follow.

“And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him”. Look at what it says the devil did: he put it into the heart of Judas. He did not reach in and move Judas's hands. He put the thought there, and Judas acted on that thought and betrayed Christ.

This is the same pattern as Job's wife. Satan works through the thought process. He watches, he looks for the one who will receive the thought, and he plants it. Everything after that is the person's own decision. That is why nobody can say, the devil made me do it. You made you do it.

Peter's warning fits right here: the adversary walks about “seeking whom he may devour”. He is searching for a heart that will take the thought and carry it out, the way Judas did.

Christ told his disciples what was coming: he would be betrayed and killed by the Pharisees, the scribes and the Sadducees. Then “Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.” Peter was saying, I am not going to allow that to happen.

“But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.” Christ was supposed to die for the sins of the nation, and Satan whispered to Peter to stand in the way. Christ spotted Satan from a distance, and Peter did not even know Satan was there. That is how crafty and cunning Satan is.

Did Peter have good intentions? He did. But even when good is present, evil is always there. So good intentions are not enough; you have to measure and weigh the words you are about to speak and filter them through the word of God, to see whether this is God's intention or your own desires being worked on by the voice of Satan.

If your mind is not in tune with the scriptures, he can whisper something through your thoughts and take control and manipulate you. Being sober and vigilant means checking even your good ideas against the word.

Wisdom “goeth about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably unto them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.” The devil walks about seeking whom he may devour, and wisdom goes about seeking those worthy of her. Wisdom has to meet you in every thought.

When a thought comes to your mind, measure it: what is the outcome of this thought? Say you get into an argument with your husband. The first thought says, say this certain word, and you can trigger him and make him feel the way you feel. Those thoughts are being fed to you: say this, say this. Wisdom filters that thought and makes sure it has godly intentions before it comes out of your mouth.

Paul wrote in 2 Corinthians 13:10 that he used his words “according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.” The power God gave us is for edification. With every thought, ask: am I exhorting this person, or could the way I am saying it destroy them? Even good intentions and exhortation can land the wrong way.

It works the other way too. Someone may say something to you that was positive when they said it, but it hits you as negative because Satan knows what you are going through and used that person's vessel. Then comes the thought: why would they say that to you? Say this back. You choose whether to respond for edification or unto destruction, whether to bring contention or to wink at ignorance. Everything is a choice.

“I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?” Job had to literally make a covenant: I'm not going to watch that, and if it gets within my eyesight, I got to turn away. I got to train my eyes to look away.

That is the three-second rule. The eyes are input. If you let yourself look at something for more than three seconds, it goes into your working memory, your short-term memory; keep looking at it and you are programming yourself into long-term memory. Turn away within three seconds and it doesn't have time to work within your memory. That is why TikTok gives you three seconds to capture somebody's attention, and why Netflix keeps it moving: once they have your attention through your eyes, they have you. Our eyes are the portal to take control over your vessel.

The algorithm is a reflection of you. Your searches and your scrolls tell who you are, what makes you sad, what makes you mad, what music you play when you're angry. So when you say the algorithm got you, it's not them getting you. It's you, manifested on a screen. The devil don't make you do anything you don't want to do.

David said the same: “I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes.” Train your eyes. If a show is full of action but something enticing comes on that goes against your values and your struggles, turn it off, click by. If you hear gossip or something negative, leave the conversation, because three seconds of listening will taint you, and three seconds of something negatively influencing you will control you.

“Remember that a wicked eye is an evil thing: and what is created more wicked than an eye? therefore it weepeth upon every occasion.” The eye is where it starts. It starts with the desire of what you see, and then the mind decides whether to feed the lust.

That is why it belongs with Matthew 15. The Pharisees were arguing about eating with unwashed hands, and Christ told them that what goes in at the mouth goes into the belly and “is cast out into the draught”, but “those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.” What comes out of your mouth is the output value of what was put into your mind, and the eye is one of the ways it gets put in.

The brain stores everything you let in. A random song or thought from years ago comes out of you because it was saved in long-term memory, the same way your stuff on the internet never really leaves. What you put into your vessel determines what comes out, and a lot of times we don't even realize we are being controlled. You were made in a factory called America, and those are not your words. The only way to break that code is to reprogram and recode, and the wicked eye is where the guarding has to begin.

Idumea is Edom, and Edom today is Europe and America and those Europeans in the land of Israel that call themselves Jews. The sword is bathed in heaven, that is the high ones, and it comes down upon Idumea, so the heaven is the Europeans.

“and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” God has cursed the white man; he has cursed the Europeans. That is why they have no pigment in their skin. And the sword comes down upon them to judgment: God is going to judge the high ones that are on high.

So when Revelation 12:12 says “Therefore rejoice, ye heavens”, the heavens are Edom. Rejoice now, this is your kingdom, have fun, because the sword that is bathed in heaven is coming down on you to judgment.

This explains the woe to the inhabiters of the earth. “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” He is America. The iron weapon is the missile, ballistic missiles, nuclear missiles, and the bow of steel is nuclear weapons. “It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall”: it is called a glittering sword because that is what the missiles look like when they are shooting.

“The heaven shall reveal his iniquity”. That is what you are seeing right now: the Lord is revealing the wickedness America is doing on the earth. “and the earth shall rise up against him.” The high ones on high will be oppressing the nations on the earth; they will oppress Iran, they will oppress Saudi Arabia, they will oppress all nations, and even Europe is going to get it too. And as they do that, all the kings of the earth are going to rise up against America and Israel because of that oppression.

What you see now is the beginning, and it is going to get worse. Many are hailing Iran for shooting missiles, but America could drop one of its crazy bombs, not even the nuclear one, and Iran would be done. Yet Iran will not be fully taken out, and there will be no regime change. The people of Iran will hate America even more; there will be a truce, not peace, after America bombs their nuclear sites, and according to prophecy they will rebuild it all. The powers that be think they are buying time, but the Lord is behind all of it.

That is the great wrath of Revelation 12:12. The devil comes down on the inhabiters of the earth because he knows his time is short. Every move he makes is to buy time and prolong his rule, because in his mind his house will go on forever: make sure the Arabs never come together, make sure Iran never gets nuclear capability, and bomb them. And once he finishes with the nations he is coming for us, the leaders in IUIC, to stop us from prophesying and testifying, because when we testify against him, judgment comes. They are already putting the laws in place.
